sa: शाखायां तस्य वृक्षस्य विस्तीर्णायां नराधिप। पर्यङ्के पृथिवीपाल दिव्यास्तरणसंस्तुते॥
en: O great king, O descendant of Bharata, I then saw seated on a cot overlaid with a celestials bed and attached to one of the farextending boughs of that banian trce.

sa: त्वदभिद्रोहसंयुक्तं युद्धमुत्पत्स्यते महत्। तत्र भीमो गदाधातैस्तवोरुं भेत्स्यते बली॥
en: In the great war which will spring out of the wrongs perpetrated by you (on the Pandavas) the mighty Bhima shall smash your that thigh with a blow of his club.

sa: नौस्थश्च मां प्रतीक्षेथास्ततो मुनिजनप्रिय। आगमिष्याम्यहं शृङ्गी विज्ञेयस्तेन तापस॥
en: O beloved of the Rishis, while remaining in that ark wait for me, and I shall appear to you in the shape of a homed animal. O ascetic, recognise me then.

sa: सोऽनुमान्य नरश्रेष्ठान् पाण्डवान् कुरनन्दनान्। नियोगाद् राजसिंहस्य गन्तुमर्हसि सत्तम॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, O excellent one, with the permission of these best of men, the Pandavas, you should at the command of that lion among kings (Dhritarashtra) return to him.

sa: अत्रिरुवाच कथितो मे महाभागे गौतमेन महात्मना। वैन्योधर्मार्थसंयुक्तः सत्यव्रतसमन्वितः॥
en: Atri said: O highly fortunate (wife), I have been told by the noble-minded Gautama that Vainya is religious, conversant with (the principles of the science of) profit and devoted to truth.

sa: महाबलैर्वेगिभिरुन्नदद्भिः। न सेहिरे वेगवतां महात्मनां वेगं तदाधारयितुं दिवौकसाम्॥
en: Being attacked by the high-souled and greatly powerful, swift-coursing and loudly roaring celestials, they (the Danavas) were unable to withstand the on set of those swift and courageous dwellers of heaven.

sa: अशुभैः कर्मभिः पापास्तिर्यनिरयगामिनः। संसारेषु विचित्रेषु पच्यमानाः पुनः पुनः॥
en: They were born among lower animals or driven to hell and again and again had to suffer the pain of rebirth in this wonderful world on account of their vicious deeds.

sa: सौतिरुवाच चिन्तयित्वा ततो वह्निश्चक्रे संहारमात्मनः। द्विजानामग्निहोत्रेषु यज्ञसत्रक्रियासु च॥
en: Sauti said: After reflecting for some time, Agni withdrew himself from all places in the world. (he withdrew himself) from the Agnihotra of the twice-born, yajnas, satras and from other ceremonies.

sa: सौतिरुवाच जाम्बूनदमयो भूत्वा मरीचिनिकरोज्ज्वलः। प्रविवेश बलात्पक्षी वारिवेग इवार्णवम्॥
en: Sauti said : The great bird, assuming a golden body, bright as the rays of the sun, entered (where the Soma was) with great force as a torrent enters the sea.

sa: त्रैलोक्यविजयार्थाय समाधायैकनिश्चयम्। दीक्षां कृत्वा गतौ विन्ध्यं तावुनं तेपतुस्तपः॥
en: Always entertaining the same purpose and ever desiring of subjugating the three worlds, the brothers went after due initiation to the mountains of Vindhya; and going there, they performed served penances.

sa: अदित्यां द्वादशादित्याः संभूता भुवनेश्वराः। ये राजन्नामतस्तांस्ते कीर्तयिष्यामि भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, from Aditi were born the twelve. Adityas, who were all lords of the Universe. I shall now mention them to you according to their names.

sa: नागक्षयकरश्चैव काश्यपेयो महाबलः। देवानां च हिते युक्तस्त्वहितौ दैत्यरक्षसाम्॥
en: He is the mighty son of Kashyapa, he is the destroyer of the Nagas, the enemy of the Daityas and Rakshasas, he is ever engaged to do good to the celestials.

sa: देवयान्युवाच कथमाशीविषात् सर्पाज्ज्वलनात् सर्वतोमुखात्। दुराधर्षतरो विप्र इत्यात्य पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Devayani said : O best of men, why do you say that a Brahmana is to be avoided like an angry and virulently poisonous snake, or a blazing and flaming fire?

sa: परिष्वज्य च तस्याथ मूर्धानं स्नेहविक्लवः। अङ्गराज्याभिषेकामश्रुभिः सिषिचे पुनः॥
en: He (Adhiratha) embraced him (Karna) and wetted his head with tears, his head which was still wet with the water sprinkled over it at his coronation as the king of Anga.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इदमत्यद्भुतं चान्यदास्तीकस्यानुशुश्रुम। तथा वरैश्छन्द्यमाने राज्ञा पारिक्षितेन हि॥
en: Sauti said : Now hsar, (I shall mention) another wonderful incident in connection with Astika. When the son of Parikshit, the king (Janamejaya) was about to grant the boon (to Astika).

sa: तदन्तकज्वलनसमानवर्चसं पुनः पुनर्व्यपतत वेगवत्तदा। विदारयद्दितिदनुजान्सहस्रशः करेरितं पुरुषवरेण संयुगे॥
en: That discus, blazing like the fire at the great dissolution of the universe being hurled by the hand of Narayana, continually falling everywhere, destroyed the Daityas and the Danavas by thousands.

sa: विद्यया ह्यनया राजन् वयं नृभ्यो विशेषिताः। अविशिष्टाश्च देवानामनुभावप्रदर्शिनः॥
en: O king, (only) on account of this science, we have a superiority over men. Because we are capable of seeing everything (by our spiritual eyes), we are equal to the celestials.

sa: उच्चावचं पार्थिवभोजनीयं पात्रीषु जाम्बूनदराजतीषु। दासाश्च दास्यश्च सुमृष्टवेषाः सम्भोजकाश्चाप्युपजहरन्नम्॥
en: After those heroes were seated, well dressed male and female servants and skillful cooks brought excellent and costly viands, on plates made of gold and silver, food worthy of kings alone.

sa: ते शश्वद् गोधनाकीर्णमम्बुमन्तं शुभदुमम्। गोरथं गिरिमासाद्य ददृशुर्मागधं पुरम्॥
en: Getting on the (hill) Goratha, they saw the city of the Magadha king, full of kine, wealth and water. It was very beautiful with the trees that stood everywhere in it.

sa: अब्रवीत् पुरुषव्याघ्रः प्रहसन्निव भारत। वनेचरस्य किमिदं कामेनालोड्यते मनः॥
en: descendant of Bharata, spoke thus to that best of men (Arjuna) with smiles, “How is it that the mind of one who roams in the forest is thus agitated by desire?

sa: चन्द्रस्तु दितिजश्रेष्ठो लोके ताराधिपोपमः। चन्द्रवर्मेति विख्यातः काम्बोजानां नराधिपः॥
en: That best of the Diti's sons, who was known as Chandra and who was as handsome as the lord of the stars (moon), became Chandravarman, the king of Kambojas on earth.

sa: कच्चिदष्टादशान्येषु स्वपक्षे दश पञ्च च। त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरविज्ञातैत्सि तीर्थानि चारकैः॥
en: Do you ascertain by means of three and three spies who are all unaccounted with one another everything about the eighteen Tirthas of the enemy and fifteen of your own means?

sa: कोपो वा धर्मशीलस्य धर्मलोपोऽथवा पुनः। धर्मलोपो गरीयान्वै स्यादित्यत्राकरोन्मतिम्॥
en: On the one hand is his anger and on the other is his loss of virtue. The loss of virtue is the greater evil of the two, this is my belief.

sa: सोऽयमस्माननुप्राप्तो वारः कुलविनाशनः। भोजनं पुरुषश्चैकः प्रदेयं वेतनं मया॥
en: The race destroying turn of (supplying food to the Rakshsasa) has come round to me. I shall have to give the food and a man as the remuneration of the (Rakshasas).

sa: रावणाननशङ्काश्च काश्चिद् रावणयोषितः। मुखानि च सपत्नीनामुपाजिघ्रन् पुनः पुनः॥
en: Out of fear sprung from sleep and intoxication, some of Rāvana's wives were again and again smelling the faces of those, co-wives with them, taking the faces to belong to Rāvaņa.

sa: ततस्तं प्रस्थितं सीता वीक्षमाणा पुनःपुनः। भर्तृस्नेहान्वितं वाक्यं सौहार्दादनुमानयत्॥
en: And gazing at him once and again as he prepared to go away, Sītā froin affection honoured the speech which had been uttered (by Hanuman) out of attachment to his master.

sa: सम्भक्ष्य सर्वभूतानि युगान्ते पर्युपस्थिते। यः शेते जलमध्यस्थस्तं प्रपद्येऽम्बुशायिनम्॥
en: I seek the protection of Him who, when the end of the cycle sets in, devours all creatures and lies down on the wide sheet of water that covers the universe.

sa: वधाभिप्रायमायान्तमधीस्त्वं महाबलम्। रक्षसस्तस्य भगिनी किं न: क्रुद्धा करिष्यति॥
en: You have killed the greatly powerful (Rakshasas) who came with the purpose of killing us. She is (but) his sister, what can she do to us, even if she is angry?

sa: इन्द्रप्रस्थे ददौ राज्यं वज्राय परवीरहा। वज्रेणाङ्करदारास्तु वार्यमाणाः प्रवव्रजुः॥
en: The rule of Indraprastha was given to Vajra. The widows of Akrura then wished to retire into the forest. Vajra asked them repeatedly to desist, but they did not hear him.

sa: न वनं गन्तुकामस्य त्यजतश्च वसुंधराम्। सर्वलोकातिगस्येव लक्ष्यते चित्तविक्रिया॥
en: There was manifest in his no change of mind, who was about to fly as an exile to the forest and leave the world, like to one emancipated while yet living.

sa: राज्यं सर्वामिषं नित्यमार्जवेनेह धार्यते। तस्मान्मिश्रेण सततं वर्तितव्यं युधिष्ठिर॥
en: A kingdom, which is sought for by all like meat can never be protected by candour and simplicity. A king, O Yudhishthira, should, therefore, always resort to both candour and wiliness.

sa: यो ह्यसत्प्रग्रहरतिः स्नेहरागबलात्कृतः। इन्द्रियाणामनीशत्वादसज्जनबुभूषकः॥ तस्य भृत्या विगुणतां यान्ति सर्वे कुलोद्गताः। न च भृत्यफलैरथैः स राजा सम्प्रयुज्यते॥
en: That king, who, taken away by his natural propensities and proclivities, become devoted to evil companions, and flatters wicked men for his being under the influence of his senses, find all servants of good birth and blood displeased with him. Such a king never gets those objects the accomplishment of which depends upon one's having a number of good servants about him.

sa: गृहीतास्त्रोऽस्मि भगवन् दुराधर्षः सुरैरपि। अस्त्राणां त्वहमिच्छामि संहारान् मुनिपुङ्गव॥
en: O adorable one, I have received these weapons, incapable of being repressed even by the celestials themselves. Now, O best of ascetics, I would acquire a knowledge of with drawing them.

sa: बद्धगोधामुलित्राणे प्रगृहीतशरासने। कथं पुरुषमानी स्यात् पुरुषाणां मयि स्थिते॥
en: Who is there, proud of his own prowess, that ! shall be able to withstand me when I shall appear at the battle field with bows and leathern fences of fingers.

sa: यथास्य पुत्रो गुणवाननुरक्तश्च पाण्डवान्। तस्मान्नो पायसाध्यांस्तानहं मन्ये कथंचन॥
en: His son is also well-accomplished and has become attached to the Pandavas; therefore, I think by no subtle machinations that are in your power, you will be able to injure them.

sa: ते पिवन्त इवाकाशं युयुधानं हयोत्तमाः॥ प्रापयन् यवनाशीघ्रं मन:पवनरंहसः।
en: Those excellent steeds, possessed of the fleetness of the wind or the mind, dashed forward scanning to devour the very skies and bore Yuyudhana to the spot where those Vas were,

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तोऽभिप्रशस्यैतत् परमर्षस्तु शासनम्। मोक्षधर्मार्थसंयुक्तमिदं प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by his father, Shuka, highly praising these instructions of the great Rishi, began to ask the following questions regarding the import of duties which brings on Liberation.

sa: अस्य गात्रगतान् बाणान् कार्णिबाहुबलार्पितान्। उद्धरन्त्यसुखाविष्टा मूर्छमानाः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Engaged in taking out from his person the with which it was pierced by Abhimanyu with the full force of his arms, those ladies are again and again losing their consciousness.

sa: पितुर्वचनमाज्ञाय तमेवार्थं विचिन्तयन्। अध्वानं सोऽतिचक्राम खेचरः खे चरन्निवा१६॥
en: In obedience to the commands of his father and bearing them constantly in his mind, he gradually passed along his way on the Earth like a bird passing through the air.

sa: एवमेवापरां संध्या समुपासीत वाग्यतः। नेक्षेतादित्यमुद्यन्तं नास्तं यान्तं कदाचन॥
en: In this way, one should when evening sets in say his evening prayers also, controlling speech the while. One should never look at the rising sun, nor at the setting sun.

sa: गुरुतल्पी गुरुद्रोही गुरुकुत्सारतिश्च यः। ब्रह्मविच्चापि पतति ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मयोनितः॥
en: That Brahmana who violates the bed of his preceptor, or who takes a pleasure in speaking ill of him, falls away from the status of Brahmanahood even if he knows Brahma.

sa: घटोत्कचस्ततो राजन् भगदत्त महारणे। शरैः प्रच्छादयामास मेरुं गिरिमिवाम्बुदः॥
en: Thereupon, O mighty monarch, in the fierce engagement that commenced Ghatotkacha covered Bhagadatta with a shower of arrows, like a rain cloud covering the Meru mountain with a downpour of rain.

sa: घोरमारोदनं मन्ये गते मयि भविष्यति। इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाशश्च नाशश्चैव वनौकसाम्॥
en: I fancy that a loud wailing shall arise on my return (to that place); and the race of Iksvāku as well as the rangets of the woods shall meet with destruction.

sa: हूंहूंहूंकारपाराय हूंहूंकारप्रियाय च। नमः शमशमे नित्यं गिरिवृक्षालयाय च॥१००।
en: Salutations to you who are above three Huns, and who are fond of two Huns. Salutations to you who are greatly tranquil, and who live under the shade of mountain trees.

sa: क्षिप्रमुत्पततो मन्ये सीतामादाय रक्षसः। बिभ्यतो रामबाणानामन्तरा पतिता भवेत्॥
en: I conceive that while taking Sītā, the Rākşasa darted upward, he being influenced by fear of Rāma's shafts; (and accordingly losing control over his movements), she fell off by the way.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा वासुदेवस्तु चिकीर्षुः सत्यमेव तत्। आज्ञापयामास तदा तीर्थयात्रामरिंदमः॥
en: Vasudeva, having said so, tried to bring about those occurrences which would make Gandhari's words true. That chastiser of enemies commanded the Vrishnis to make a pilgrimage to some sacred water.

sa: इत्युक्त्वान्तर्हितो विप्रस्ततोऽहं विस्मिताभवम्। न च सर्वास्ववस्थासु रमृतिर्मे विप्रणश्यति॥
en: Having said these words, the twice-born one vanished away from my sight. I becamefilled with wonder. The Mantra, however, which the Rishi gave has lived in my memory at all times.

sa: अष्टकस्त्वथ राजर्षिः कौशिको माधवीसुतः। अनेकशतयज्वानं नाहुषं प्राप्य धर्मवित्॥
en: And the royal Rishi Ashtaka too, the son of Madhvi, by the son of Kushika, conversant with virtue, addressing the son of Nahusha who had performed many hundreds of sacrifices, said:

sa: अथ वर्षसहस्रेण योक्त्रसर्पशिरांसि च। वमन्तोऽतिविषं तत्र ददंशुर्दशनैः शिलाः॥
en: After a thousand years had gone by, the hoods (of the serpent) serving as the churning cord, began to vomit virulent venom and to bite at the crags, with their fangs.

sa: एवं स पुत्रपौत्राणां पितृणामात्मनस्तथा। गान्धार्याश्च महाराज प्रददावौर्ध्व देहिकम्॥
en: It was thus, O king, that that monarch made gifts for the behoof, in the other world, of his sons and grandsons and departed manes as also of himself and Gandhari.

sa: ततस्ते भ्रातरः सर्वं धनञ्जयमचोदयन्। स जले प्राक्षिपच्चैतत्तथाक्षय्ये महेषुधी॥
en: At this, all the brothers requested Dhananjaya to do what the god said. He then threw into the waters (of the sea) both the bow and the couple of inexhaustible quivers.

sa: गजौघवेगोद्धतसादितानां श्रुत्वा विषेदुः सहसा मनुष्याः। आस्विनं सादिपदातियूनां विषाणगात्रावरताडितानाम्॥
en: Having heard the wails of horsemen and foot soldiers, struck with the tusks and other limbs of elephants or crushed by their huge animals fell down on the field of battle.

sa: मदीनवत् सत्पुरुषोत्तमाभ्याम्। ददर्श लोकः कुरुसुंजयाच तद् द्वैरथं भीष्मधनंजयाभ्याम्॥
en: Then the Kurus, the Srinjayas, and all other people saw the single combat between those two foremost of men, Bhishma and Arjuna both distinguished by the fearful twang of their bows.

sa: सिन्धुराजवधार्थाय प्रतिज्ञाते त्वयानघ। कृष्णेन दर्शितः स्वप्ने यस्तु शैलेन्द्रमूर्धनि॥
en: After you had vowed to slay the ruler of the Sindhus, O sinless one, Krishna showed your this god, in your deam, seated on the top of that best of mountains.

sa: वेदान् कृत्वाऽथ चतुरश्चतुरश्वान् महेश्वरः॥ उपवेदान् खलीनांश्च कृत्वा लोकत्रयेश्वरः।
en: The mighty god then made the four Vedas the four steeds of his chariot; the lord of the three worlds made the auxiliaries of the Vedas the bridle-bits of his steeds.

sa: सूर्याचन्द्रमसोलोके प्रकाशन्ते रुचश्च याः। ताः केशसंज्ञितास्त्र्यक्षे व्योमकेशस्ततः स्मृतः॥
en: They rays of light that proceeding from the Sun and Moon, are seen in the worlds, are said to be the hair of his head and therefore is he called Vyomakesa.

sa: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने। पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते फलोदयः॥
en: Or you alone, O destroyer of hostile heroes, are quite enough for the fulfilment of this purpose; and you shall reap, in the shape of fame, the fruit of your achievement.

sa: तदेतद्भयमुत्पन्नं त्रायस्वेह महाबल। नाशय त्वमिमानद्य तदर्थं बोधितो भवान्॥
en: Therefore has this fear sprung up in my heart). Save me from this, O exceedingly powerful one. Do you now destroy these. It is for this that I have roused you.

sa: चक्रे शरविघातं चक्रीडन्निव पितामहः॥ नाभिसंधत्त पाञ्चाल्ये स्मयमानो मुहुर्मुहः।
en: The grandsire then repulsed all those arrows as if in sport. He did not aim any shafts at the prince of the Panchalas, but laughingly looked at him now and then.

sa: दृष्ट्वा मद्रेश्वररथं धार्तराष्ट्राः पराङ्मुखम्। सर्वे विमनसो भूत्वा नेदमस्तीत्यचिन्तयन्॥
en: The sons of Dhritarashtra beholding the car of the ruler of the Madras turn away from the field, were all depressed in mind and thought that he was no longer alive.

sa: तस्येदानीं तमसः सम्भवस्य पुरुषस्य ब्रह्मयोनेर्ब्रह्मणः प्रादुर्भावे स पुरुषः प्रजाः सिसृक्षमाणो नेत्राभ्यामग्नीषोमौ ससर्ज। ततो भूतसर्गेषु सृष्टेषु प्रजाक्रमवशाद् ब्रह्मक्षत्रमुपातिष्ठत्। यः सोमस्तद् ब्रह्म यद् ब्रह्म ते ब्राह्मणा योऽग्निस्तत् क्षत्रं क्षत्राद् ब्रह्म बलवत्तरम्। कस्मादिति लोकप्रत्यक्षगुणमेतत्तद्यथा। ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परं भूतं नोत्पन्नपूर्व दीप्येमानेऽग्नौ जुहोति। यो ब्राह्मणमुखे जुहोतीति कृत्वा ब्रवीमि भूतसर्गः कृतो ब्रह्मणा भूर नि च प्रतिष्ठाप्य त्रैलोक्यं धार्यत इति मन्त्रवादोऽपि ह
en: From that Purusha thus born of Tamas and having Brahma for his parent, came into existence the Being called Brahman. Brahman, wishing to create creatures caused Agni and Soma to originate from his own own eyes. Afterwards when creatures were to be created, the ceated persons came out in their due order as Brahmanas and Kshatriyas. He who came into being as Soma was none else than Brahma; and they that were born as Brahmanas were all Soma in sooth. He who came into Being as Agni was none else than Kshatriya. The Brahmanas became gifted with greater energy than the Kshatriyas. If you enquire about the reason thereof, the answer is that this superiority of the Brahmanas to the Kshatriyas is an attribute which is manifest to the whole world. It occurred as follows. The Brahmanas represent the

sa: प्राणातिपाते यो रौद्रो दण्डहस्तोद्यतः सदा। नित्यमुद्यतशस्त्रश्च हन्ति भूतगणान् नरः॥ निर्दयः सर्वभूतानां नित्यमुद्वेगकारकः। अपि कीटपिपीलानामशरण्यः सुनिघृणः॥ एवंभूतो नरो देवि निरयं प्रतिपद्यते। विपरीतस्तु धर्मात्मा रूपवानभिजायते॥
en: That man who assumes a dreadful aspect for the purpose of taking the lives of other creatures, who arms himself with strong sticks for injuring other creatures, who is seen with uplifted weapons, who kills living creatures, who is shorn of mercy, who always causes tribulation to living beings, who refuses to grant protection to even worms and ants, who is cruel, one who is such, O goddess, sinks in Hell. One who has an opposite disposition and who is righteous in deeds, becomes born as a handsome man.

sa: घोरैर्दत्तवरैर्बद्धौ शरैराशीविषोपमैः। अमोघैः सूर्यसंकाशैः प्रमध्येन्द्रजिता युधि ॥ तदनबन्धमासाद्य यदि मुक्तौ रिपू मम। संशयस्थमिदं सर्वमनुपश्याम्यहं बलम्॥
en: Indrajit, having routed them in conflict, had bound them by means of irresistible and terrible arrows, resembling venomous serpents, and like to the Sun himself, which had been conferred on (Indrajit) as boons. But if my enemy having actually been bound by the weapons, can have been liberated, all this strength of mine I see placed in peril.

sa: गायन्त्यथ च नृत्यन्ति स्त्रियो मत्ता विवाससः। नगरागारवप्रेषु बहिर्माल्यानुलेपनाः॥ मत्तावगीतैर्विविधैः खरोष्ट्रनिनदोपमैः। अनावृता मैथुने ताः कामचाराश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Their women all drink and are nude and laugh and dance, outside the walls of the houses in cities, with garlands and unguents, singing under the influence of liquor various obscene songs like the bray of the ass or the bleat of lambs. They freely mix and intercourse with all. Inebrite they address one another with endearing terms.

sa: आर्यायनिः समरे दुष्प्रकम्प्यः सेनाग्रणीः प्रथमस्तावकानाम्। यः स्वस्त्रीयान् पाण्डवेयान् विसृज्य सत्यां वाचं स्वां चिकीर्षुस्तरस्वी॥ तेजोवधं सूतपुत्रस्य संख्ये प्रतिश्रुत्याजातशत्रोः पुरस्तात्। दुराधर्षः शक्रसमानवीर्यः शल्यः स्थितो योद्धुकामस्त्वदर्थे॥
en: Having forsaken the sons of his own sister, the Pandavas, with the desire of making good his words, that son of Artayana, who never trembles in battle, who is the head of all the warriors and the first of those on your side, who is possessed of immense activity and who has promised before Ajatasatru that he would destroy the energy of the son of Suta in battle, who is Shakra's peer in prowess, that hero Shalya is still staying in the field desirous of fighting for your sake.

sa: परं तु शुक्लं विमलं विशोकं गतक्लमं सिद्ध्यति दानवेन्द्र। गत्वा तु योनिप्रभवाणि दैत्य सहस्रशः सिद्धिमुपैति जीवः॥
en: The White is the foremost colour, It is sinless on account of its being free from attachment and aversion. It is without grief, and free from the exertion necessary by desire for action. Hence, White, O king of Danavas, brings on Liberation. O Daitya, having undergone thousands of births derived through the womb, Individual Soul attains to success.

sa: ब्राह्मणप्रतिपूजायामायुः कीर्तिर्यशो बलम्। लोका लोकेश्वराश्चैव सर्वे ब्राह्मणपूजकाः॥ त्रिवर्गे चापवर्गे च यश:श्रीरोगशान्तिषु। देवतापितृपूजासु संतोष्याश्चैव नो द्विजाः॥
en: From the adoration of the Brahinanas originate achievements and fame and strength. Men and the Regents of the universe, adore the Brahmanas. We should satisfy the Brahmanas for the sake of accomplishment on holy deeds, wealth and desires, for attainment of emancipation, fame, grace and health as also at the time of offering pray to gods and Pitris.

sa: प्रत्यासत्रक्रमेणापि भरतस्यैव भामिनि । राज्यक्रमो विसृष्टस्तु तयोस्तावद्यवीयसोः॥ विदुषः क्षत्रचारित्रे प्राज्ञस्य प्राप्तकारिणः। भयात्प्रवेपे रामस्य चिन्तयन्ती तवात्मजम्॥
en: With reference to gradation of birth, the probability is in favour of Bharata's attempting the kingdom; yet by reason (of Rāma's being the elder) of the two Bharata has been thrown off. Anticipating the peril that might spring to your son from Rāma, learned and versed in the functions of the Kșatriya, and of quick decision, I tremble.

sa: श्वपच उवाच नैतत्खादन्प्राप्नुते दीर्घमायु नैव प्राणान्नामृतस्येव तृप्तिः। भिक्षामन्यां भिक्ष मा ते मनोऽस्तु श्वभक्षणेश्वा ह्यभक्ष्यो द्विजानाम्॥
en: The Chandala said By eating this food one like yourself cannot live long. Nor can one (like you) get strength (from such food), nor that gratification which ambrosia yields. Do you beg for some other kind of alms. Be not bent upon eating dog's imeat. The meat of dog is, forsooth, an impure food for the twice-born ones.

sa: आन्तरैरभिसंधाय राजन् सिद्ध्यति नान्यथा॥ तेषामहं भयाद् राजन् गमिष्याम्यन्यमाश्रमम्। तैर्हि मे संधितो बाणः काके निपतितः प्रभो॥
en: Through fear of those men, O king, I shall leave this kingdom for some other hermitage. I have no worldly desire, yet those deceitful persons have shot this arrow at my crow, and have, O lord, sent the bird to Yama's abode. I have seen this, O king, with eyes whose vision has been improved by ascetic penances.

sa: कीर्तितान् कीर्तयिष्यामि सर्वपापप्रमोचनान्। यवक्रीतोऽथ रैभ्यश्च कक्षीवानौशिजस्तथा॥ भृग्वङ्गिरास्तथा कण्वो मेधातिथिरथ प्रभुः। बी च गुणसम्पन्न: प्राची दिशमुपाश्रिताः॥
en: After this recital of the deities, I shall name those learned Brahmanas crowned with ascetic merit and success and capable of purifying one of every sin. They are Yavakrita and Raibhya and Kakshivat and Aushija, and Bhrigu and Angirasa and Kanva and the powerful Medhatithi, and Varhi endued with every accomplishment. These all belong to the Eastern region.

sa: रेणुका उवाच अनुज्ञातोऽस्मि देवैश्च पितृभिश्च महाबलाः। धर्मगुह्यानि युष्माकं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः। कथयध्वं महाभागा यद् वस्तत्त्वं मनीषितम्॥
en: Going where those elephants are, Renuka address them, saying, Ye powerful creature have been commanded by the celestials and the departed Manes to question you about the mysteries of religion and duty! I desire to hear you discourse on that subject in detail. Ye highly blessed ones, do ye discourse on the subject as your wisdom may dictate.

sa: भीष्म उवाच वरमिदमिति भूमिदो विचिन्त्य प्रवरमृषेर्वचनं ततो महात्मा। व्यसृजत नियतात्मवान् द्विजेभ्यः सुबहु च गोधानमाप्तवांश्च लोकान्॥
en: Bhishma said Considering these words of the Rishi Vasishtha as highly important, that great giver of land, king Saudasa, then made gifts of a very large number of kine to the Brahmanas, controlling his senses all the while, and as the result of those gifts, the king succeeded in acquiring many regions of happiness in the next world.

sa: शापो ह्ययं भवतोऽनुग्रहाय प्राप्तो मया यत्र दृष्ट्वा यमो वै। दानव्युष्टिं तत्र दृष्ट्वा महात्मन् नि:संदिग्धान् दानधर्मोश्चरिष्ये॥
en: The curse that you had imprecated on me was no curse but was in sooth a blessing, since it enabled me to see the great king of the dead. There I have seen what the rewards are of gifts. I shall henceforth, O you of great soul, practise the duty of gift without any doubt about its rewards.

sa: गौतम उवाच सुपुष्पितं किन्नरराजजुष्टं प्रियं वनं नन्दनं नारदस्य। गन्धर्वाणामप्सरसां च शश्वत् तत्र त्वाहं हस्तिनं यातयिष्ये॥
en: Gautama said If you go to the woods owned by Narada and held dear by him, which are adorned with flowers and which echo with the melodious songs of the prince of Kinnaras, and which are the eternal habitation of Gandharvas an Apsaras. I shall follow you there and compell you to yield up this elephant to me.

sa: विसर्जयैनं यात्वेष स्वराज्यमनुशासताम्। मास: समधिकस्तेषामतीतो वसतां वने॥
en: Do you send him away. Let him return to his kingdom and rule it! They have passed more then a month in thus living in the forest.

sa: यथैनमवमन्येरन् परे सततमेव हि। यथावृत्तश्चरेच्छान्तः सतां धर्मानकुत्सयन्॥
en: Without finding fault with the practices of the good, he should act in such a way for practising piety as may induce other to always disregard him.

sa: अयं नाथस्तवाचिन्त्यो यस्य नारायणो गतिः॥ स भवांस्त्वमुपाध्व! रणाग्नौ हुतवान् नृपान्। कृष्णस्तुवेण महत्ता युगान्ताग्निसमेत वै॥
en: The fact of your having got the inconceivable Narayana for your protector and refuge, enabled you to become an Adhvaryu (chief sacrificer) for pouring multitudes of kings as libations on the burning fire of battle. This Krishna was your great sacrificial ladle resembling the all-destroying fire which appears at the end of the cycle.

sa: भूमिप्रदानान्नृपतिर्मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषात्। न हि भूमिप्रदानेन दानमत्यद् विशिष्यते॥
en: A king, by making gifts of earth, is purged off of all his sins. There is no gift, therefore, which is superior to the gift of earth.

sa: दिव्याम्बरधराः सर्वे सर्वे भ्राजिष्णुकुण्डलाः। निर्वैरा निरहङ्कारा विगतक्रोधमत्सराः॥
en: All of them were dressed in celestial vestments and all had brilliant earning. They were free from all animosity and pride and divested of anger and jealousy.

sa: श्रिया ह्यभीक्ष्णं संवासो दर्पयेत् सम्प्रमोहयेत्। ब्राह्मणेषु प्रमूढेषु धर्मो विप्रणशेद् ध्रुवम्। धर्मप्रणाशे भूतानामभावः स्यान्न संशयः॥
en: Constant association with riches and prosperity is sure to fill him with pride and cause him to be stupefied. If the Brahmanas become stupefied and steeped in folly., virtue and duties are sure to suffer destruction. Forsooth, if virtue and duty come to an end, it will lead to the destruction of all creatures.

sa: शुशुभे तत्पुरं चापि समुद्रौघनिभस्वनम्। नर्तकैश्चापि नृत्यद्भिर्गायकानां च निःस्वनैः॥ आसीद् वैश्रवणस्येव निवासस्तत्पुरं तदा। बन्दिभिश्च नरै राजन् स्त्रीसहायैश्च सर्वशः॥ तत्र तत्र विविक्तेषु समन्तादुपशोभितम्। पताका धूयमानाश्च समन्तापन्मातस्श्विना॥ अदर्शयन्निव तदा कुरून् वै दक्षिणोत्तरान्। अघोषयंस्तदा चापि पुरुषा राजधूर्गताः। सर्वराष्ट्रविहारोऽद्य रत्नाभरणलक्षणः॥
en: Indeed, the city was filled with the noise of thousands of voices which resembled the softened roar of distant ocean waves. With dancers all engaged in their business, and with the voice of singers, the (Kuru) city then resembled the palace of Vaishravana himself. Bards and culogists, O king, accompanied by beautiful women, were seen to adorn various retired spots in the city. The pennons were made by the wind to float gaily on every part of the city, as if bent upon showing the Kurus the southern and the northern points of the compass. All the officers also of the government loudly proclaimed that that was to be a day of rejoicing for the whole kingdom as a mark of the success of the enterprise for bringing a profusion of gems and other valuables.

sa: ततो यज्ञं महाबाहुर्वाजिमेधं महाक्रतुम्। बह्वन्नदक्षिणं राजा सर्वकामगुणान्वितम्॥
en: The mighty-armed king then performed the great Horse-Sacrifice characterised by gifts of food and presents in profusion and capable of fructifying every desire and producing cvery merit.

sa: द्वैपायन: सशिष्यश्च सिद्धाश्चान्ये मनीषिणः। शतयूपश्च राजर्षिर्वृद्धः परमधार्मिकः॥
en: The Island-born Vyasa with all his disciples, and other persons gifted success, and the royal sage Shatayupa of advanced years and possessed of greit merit, also came.

sa: ब्राह्मणायाभिरूपाय यो दद्यादन्नमर्थिने। विदधाति निधिं श्रेष्ठं पारलौकिकमात्मनः॥
en: That man who makes a gift of food to an accomplished Brahmana who begs the same, secures for himself in the next world wealth of great value.

sa: तपसश्चानुपूर्येण फलमूलाशिनस्तथा। त्रैलोक्यं तपसा सिद्धाः पश्यन्तीह समाहिताः॥
en: Likewise, those who have acquired perfection, who capable of the concentration of Yoga, and who live on fruits and roots, likewise perceive the triple world by penance.

sa: पराभूतेषु दैत्येषु शक्रस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरः। प्रजाः समुदिताः सर्वाः सत्यधर्मपरायणाः॥
en: After the demons had been defeated and Shakra had become the lord of the three worlds, all creatures grew prosperous and became devoted to the true religion.

sa: ब्रह्ममृत्यू ततो राजन्नात्मन्येव व्यवस्थितौ।। अदृश्यमानौ भूतानि योधयेतामसंशयम्॥
en: And these two, Spirit and Death, O king, have their scats in the souls of all creatures, and remaining unseen, they, forsooth, rage war with each other.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा पन्नगसुतां सपत्नी चैत्रवाहनी। ततः प्रायमुपासीना तूष्णीमासीज्जनाधिप॥
en: Having said so to the daughter of the Snake-Chief, who was a co-wife with her to Arjuna, the princess Chatravahini sat in Praya, O king, restraining speech.

sa: एतन्मण्डलमित्याहुराचार्या नीतिकोविदाः। अत्र षाड्गुण्यमायत्तं युधिष्ठिर निबोध तत्॥
en: Politicians call these by the name of Mandala. Understand, O Yudhishthira, that the six incidents (of peace, war, march, halt, sowing dissension's, and conciliation) depend upon these.

sa: अथ सर्जरसादीनां गन्धैः पार्थिव दारवैः। फाणितासवसंयुक्तर्मनुष्याणां विधीयते॥
en: Dhupas made of the exudation of the Shorea robusta and the Pinus deodara, mixed with various spirits of strong scent, are, O king, acceptable to human beings.

sa: धनं प्राप्नोति तपसा मौनेनाज्ञां प्रयच्छति। उपभोगांस्तु दानेन ब्रह्मचर्येण जीवितम्॥ अहिंसायाः फलं रूपं दीक्षाया जन्म वै कुले। फलमूलाशिनां राज्यं स्वर्गः पर्णाशिनां भवेत्॥
en: By penances one acquires riches. By observing the vow of silence one succeeds in bringing the whole world under his sway. By making gifts one gets all kinds of enjoyable articles. By observing the rite of Diksha one acquires birth in a good and high family. Those who spend their lives living upon only fruits and roots succeed in acquiring kingdom and sovereignty. Those who live upon the leaves of plants and trees as their food succeed in going to Heaven.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच ये सर्वभूतेषु निवृत्तकामा अमांसादा न्यस्तदण्डाश्चरन्ति। न हिंसन्ति स्थावरं जङ्गमं च भूतानां ये सर्वभूतात्मभूताः॥ निराशिषो निर्ममा वीतरागा लाभालाभे तुल्यनिन्दाप्रशंसाः। तथाविधानामेष लोको महर्षे परं गन्ता धृतराष्ट्रो न तत्र॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Those men who are freed from desire for all articles of enjoyment, who abstain from meat, who never take up the rod of punishment, and never inflict the least harm on mobile and immobile creatures, who have formed themselves the soul of all creatures, who never accost others by pronouncing blessings upon them, who are entirely freed from the idea of mineness, who are shorn of attachments for every thing, who view profit and loss as also praise and blame in equal light, only those men, O great Rishi, go to such regions. I shall go to a higher region. Indeed, Dhritarashtra shall not go there.

sa: स प्रयातो महाबाहुः समेषु मरुधन्वसु। ददर्शाथ मुनिश्रेष्ठमुत्तङ्कममितौजसम्॥
en: As the mighty-armed hero went on he came upon the desert ill-supplied with water. there a he saw that foremost of ascetics, named Utanka, of immeasurable energy.

sa: एवं तेषां कथयतामौत्सुक्यमभवत् तदा। गमने चाभवद् बुद्धिधृतराष्ट्रदिदृक्षया॥
en: Such was the anxiety shown by the Pandavas when they talked with one another. They then set their hearts upon beholding the king in his forest asylum.

sa: यस्मादूर्ध्वगमेतत् तु तमसश्चैव भेषजम्। तस्मादूर्ध्वगतेर्दाता भवेदत्रेति निश्चयः॥
en: Since, again, light has an upward course and is considered as a remedy for darkness, therefore one should give lights. This is the conclusion of the scriptures.

sa: एवं कथाभिरन्वास्य धृतराष्ट्र मनीषिणः। विप्रजग्मुर्यथाकामं ते सिद्धगतिमास्थिताः॥
en: Having cheered Dhritarashtra of great wisdom with such talk, they left the place, going away by the path that belongs to those who are crowned with success.

sa: तयोर्विस्पर्धतोरेवं शपथोऽयमभूत् तदा। सहसोद्दिश्य विपलुं ततो वाक्यमथोचतुः॥
en: While thus quarrelling with each other with great assurance, an oath was then heard among them. Indeed, each of them suddenly named Vipula in what they uttered.

sa: गङ्गायमुनयोर्वेगं सुभीमं भीमनिःस्वनम्। प्रतिजग्राह शिरसा वातवेगसमं जवे॥
en: Placing his head against it, he bore the fierce and roaring current of the two rivers united together,—the current whose speed resembled that of the wind itself.

sa: कथमासीञ्जनस्थाने युद्धं राक्षसगृध्रयोः। नामधेमिदं भ्रातुश्चिरस्याद्य मया श्रुतम्॥
en: How happened in Janasthāna the fight between the Rākṣasa and the vulture? It is after a long time that to-day I hear the name of my brother.

sa: अवस्यायतमोनद्धा नीहारतमसावृताः। प्रसुप्ता इव लक्ष्यन्ते विपुष्पा वनराजयः॥
en: And the rows of trees, shorn of their blossoms, on being enveloped with dew at night and mist at morn, look as if they were fast asleep.

sa: करेणुशिशुकल्पैश्च युक्तं परमवाजिभिः। हरियुक्तं सहस्राक्षो रथमिन्द्र इवाशुगम्॥
en: It had two excellent horses tied to it like to two young elephants, and was of quick motion, resembling that of Indra's chariot carried by his horses.

sa: आदित्यमुपतिष्ठन्ते नियमादूर्ध्वबाहवः। एते परे विशालाक्षि मुनयः संशितव्रताः॥
en: And observing rules, persons raising up their arms, are worshipping the sun, and, O you of expansive eyes, after these appear ascetics following vows, (engaged if Tapa)

sa: स्तनूजशोकप्रभवो महाहितः। महीमिमां रश्मिभिरुत्तमप्रभो यथानिदाघे भगवान् दिवाकरः॥
en: As in summer the divine Sun furnished with fierce rays burns this earth, even so this raging fire of grief of account of my son consumes me.

sa: त इमे बहुसाहस्रैरनीकैर्भीमविक्रमैः। आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्यदानवसंनिभाः॥
en: And in company with many thousands and innumerable ones that have shewn their ability in many a field, have come monkeys dreadful, and resembling Daityas and Dänavas.

sa: ततो रुचिरताम्राक्षो भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम्। अश्रुपूर्णमुखो दीनोऽब्रवीज्जानपदं जनम्॥
en: Then he furnished with graceful coppery eyes raising his right hand, with tears in his eyes and in forlorn guise addressed the people of the provinces, saying.

sa: क्षिप्रं वनमिदं सौम्य नरसंधैः समन्ततः। लुब्धैश्च सहितैरेभिस्त्वमन्वेषितुमर्हसि॥
en: O mild one, it behoves you at once to search this forest all round in company with a large body of men as well as these Nişadas.

sa: तां प्राञ्जलिरभिप्रेक्ष्य मातृमध्येऽतिसत्कृताम्। रामः परमधर्मात्मा मातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then with joined hands that foremost of virtuous ones addressed his mother, who, duly honoured by all, was seated in the midst of his other mothers, saying.

sa: यन्मन्यसे नरव्याघ्र प्राप्तकालं तदुच्यताम्। त्वत्सैन्यं त्वद्वशे युक्तमाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि॥
en: If, O lion among men, you conceive that the time is ripe, tell it (to me). It behoves you to command those forces, remaining under your sway.

sa: अन्वगच्छद् धनुष्पाणिः प्रव्रजन्तं मया सह। जटी तापसरूपेण मया सह सहानुजः॥ प्रविष्टो दण्डकारण्यं धर्मनित्यो दृढव्रतः।
en: With a bow in hand he has followed (Rama) flying as an exile to woods along with me. Thus that one (Rāma) of firm resolution and ever engaged in pious offices wearing matted hair and assuming the semblance of an ascetic has entered this forest of Dandaka along with myself and his younger brother,

sa: सुस्राव नयनैः स्त्रीणामस्रमायाससम्भवम्। मानसंक्षोभचलितैः सलिलं पङ्कजैरिव ॥
en: And the tears begot of heart's grief that flowed from the eyes of the females, resembled rain-drops scattered around from lotuses shaken by the movements of fish.

sa: आयत्तमग्निहोत्रं च बलि)मस्तथैव च। स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ विद्याश्च विविधास्तथा॥
en: And, O royal saint, my Svahākāras and Vasaſkāras* as well as my various lore depend upon her. *Sacrifice performed with the exclamation of svadhả and Vașat respectively.

sa: ग्रहणं वायुसूनोश्च लङ्कादाहाभिगर्जनम्। प्रतिप्लवनमेवाथ मधूनां हरणं तथा॥
en: The wind-god's son being taken captive; and his terrible roars while burning down Lankā; and his bounding back over the ocean; and the forcible possession of honey.

sa: सदृशं राजशार्दूल तवैव भुवि नान्यतः। महावंशप्रसूतस्य वसिष्ठव्यपदेशिनः॥
en: O tiger of a king, sprung from an illustrious line, and having Vasistha, for your guide, these words become you alone on earth and no one else.

sa: दीर्घासिबद्धगोधाश्च संनद्धा मृष्टवाससः॥ महाराजाङ्गनं शूराः प्रविशन्तु महोदयम्।
en: And let the warriors properly arrayed, enter the courtyard of the monarch which is welling up with festal glee, mailed, and accoutred with leather fences and long-swords.

sa: ततस्तानाकुलान् दृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रास्त्रमोहितान्। वसिष्ठश्चोदयामास कामधुक् सृज योगतः॥
en: And beholding them sore harassed, and overwhelmed by Visvāmitra's weapons, Vasistha directed (Sabala) saying, 'o cow of plenty, do you create (fresh troops), through your Yoga power.'

sa: एवं रामप्रयुक्तास्तु मार्गमाणास्ततस्ततः। वैदेहीं नाधिगच्छामो रात्रौ सूर्यप्रभामिव॥
en: Despatched hither by Rāma, we have searched for Sītā all round, but Vaidehī we have not found, as one does not find the solar splendour at night.

sa: तस्यां पुर्यामयोध्यायां वेदवित् सर्वसंग्रहः। दीर्घदर्शी महातेजाः पौरजानपदप्रियः॥
en: In that city of Ayodhyā resided king Dasaratha, versed in the Vedas, commanding all resources, far-sighted, of mighty prowess, dear to the inhabitants both rural and urban.

sa: तथा वसिष्ठवचनादृष्यशृङ्गस्य चोभयोः। दिवसे शुभनक्षत्रे निर्यातो जगतीपतिः॥
en: Then in accordance with the injunctions of both Vasiştha and Rşyasſga, the king came to the sacrificial spot on a day presided over by an auspicious star.

sa: राघवस्त्वपयातेषु सर्वेष्वनुविचिन्तयन्। न तत्रारोचयद् वासं कारणैर्बहुभिस्तदा ॥
en: When the ascetics had gone away, Rāghava reflected (as to his stay at that place); and from diverse reasons, he did not relish remaining there any further.

sa: उत्पातवाताभिरता नानाद्विजगणायुक्ताः। मा भैरीति विधूताग्रा व्याजह्वरिव पादपाः॥
en: The trees filled with various fowls, with their tops waving because of the wind blowing on high and swaying them, seemed to say, No fear, [to Sita.]

sa: लोकस्वभाव एवैष ययातिर्नहुषात्मजः। गतः शक्रेण सालोक्यमनयस्तं समस्पृशत्॥
en: This is the nature of men. Yayati, the son of king Nahusa, though attained to the state of celestials, was however thrown down for an iniquitous deed.

sa: चन्द्रसूर्यौ महाभागावुत्तिष्ठन्तौ परंतपौ॥ निवारयति बाहुभ्यां यः शैलशिखरोपमः।
en: And, who, himself resembling a mountain summit, had by means of his upraised arms, obstructed the rising of these repressor of foes the exalted Sun and Moon;

sa: ततोऽहं वालिना तेन सोऽनुबद्धः प्रधावितः। नदीश्च विविधाः पश्यन् वनानि नगराणि च ॥ आदर्शतलसंकाशा ततो वै पृथिवी मया। अलातचक्रप्रतिमा दृष्ट्वा गोष्पदवत् कृता॥
en: Hotly pursued and chased by Vāli, I surveyed various streams and woods and cities. And I surveyed the earth like the hoof-print of a cow, or the image reflected from a mirror, or a firebrand whirled (in the air).* *The commentator remarks that like the hoof-print of a cow expresses the case with which Sugrīva travelled the earth; like a fire brand whirled conveys his vehement speed; and like the image reflected on a mirror signifies the lucidity of his perception.

sa: तव कल्याणरुचयः कपिमुख्याः समागताः॥ मङ्गलान्यर्थसिद्ध्यर्थं करिष्यन्ति समाहिताः।
en: These foremost of monkeys assembled, who wish for your welfare, shall, with intent mind, perform acts tending to your weal,-so that you mayst succeed in your undertaking.

sa: अयं यज्ञहरोऽस्माकमनेनाश्वोऽपनीयते। इति ते सर्वभूतानि हिंसन्ति सगरात्मजाः॥
en: This one is the disturber of our sacrifice, and by him has the sacrificial horse been stolen, saying this Sagara's sons are committing havoc upon all creatures.

sa: त्वरमाणश्च धर्मात्मा रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनः। रथेन खरयुक्तेन प्रयार्ता दक्षिणामुखः॥
en: And bearing a garland of red flowers, with his body daubed with red sandal, he was fast proceeding to the south in a car yoked with asses.

sa: समः समविभक्ताङ्गः स्निग्धवर्णः प्रतापवान्। पीनवक्षा विशालाक्षो लक्ष्मीवाञ्छुभलक्षणः॥
en: And having symmetrical limbs, and of a cool hue; and possessed of prowess; and having a well-developed chest; with expansive eyes; crowned with auspiciousness and favourable marks.

sa: ततो दशाहेऽतिगते कृतशौचो नृपात्मजः। द्वादशेऽहनि सम्प्राप्ते श्राद्धकर्माण्यकारयत्॥
en: When the ten days had gone by, the king's son, his uncleanness (consequent on the demise of his father) removed, performed the sraddha on the twelfth day.

sa: बलविक्रमसम्पन्ना कामगा कामरूपिणी। इमामवस्थां नीता त्वं केनान्तकसमागता॥
en: Endowed with strength and prowess, ranging about at will, wearing shapes at pleasure, and resembling the destroyer himself, going to whom hast you come by this condition?

sa: ततस्तु मारुतप्रख्यः स हरिर्मारुतात्मजः। आरुरोह नगश्रेष्ठं महेन्द्रमरिमर्दनः॥ वृतं नानाविधैः पुष्पैर्मृगसेवितशाद्वलम्। लताकुसुमसम्बाधं नित्यपुष्पफलद्रुमम्॥ सिंहशार्दूलसहितं मत्तमातङ्गसेवितम्। मत्तद्विजगणोद्धृष्टं सलिलोत्पीडसंकुलम्॥ महद्भिरुच्छ्रितः शृङ्गैर्महेन्द्रस्य महाबलः। विचचार हरिश्रेष्ठो महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः।॥
en: Then he equalling the Wind, that monkey, the son of the Wind-god, pounder of enemies, ascended that best of mountains, Mahendra; covered with with various trees and flowers, furnished with swards; ranged by deer; containing plants and blossoms with trees bearing fruits and flowers daily; having tigers and lions and infuriated elephants; swarming with maddened birds; and abounding with fountains. Ascending (Mahendra), that foremost of monkeys endued with exceeding strength, and resembling Mahendra himself in prowess, began to range from one mighty summit to another.

sa: पुण्ड्रस्यापततो नागं चलन्तमिव पर्वतम्। सहदेवः प्रयत्नस्तैर्नाराचैरहनत् त्रिभिः॥
en: Shahadeva, on the other hand, had struck the elephant of falling Pundra, that was moving like a mountain, with three long arrows, which were most excellently directed.

sa: तमापतन्तमालोक्य सात्यकिः कौरवं रणे। अभिदुत्य महाबाहुश्छादयामास सायकैः॥
en: Possessed of mighty arms, rushed against him and covered him with his own shafts. Then those warriors headed by Dushasana being thus covered by those arrowy showers.

sa: तेऽभ्यवर्षञ्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम्। त्वरमाणा महावीरा माधवस्य बधैषिणः॥
en: Then those mighty heroes, desirous of achieving the slaughter of that scion of Madhu's race, began to pour showers of sharp arrows on Satyaki of infallible prowess.

sa: विलम्बमानमवहत् संश्लिष्टं परग्रासनम्। शरादितः सात्वतेन मर्दमान: स्ववाहिनीम्॥
en: Bore that precious seat hanging down from its back. Afflicted with the shafts of the Satvata hero, the huge animal crushed the ranks of its own party.

sa: संरब्धश्च शरानस्यन् द्रोणं दुर्वारणं रणे। विवारयिषुराचार्यं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Worked up with rage and discharging his arrows in that battle at the indomitable Drona, Dhristadyumna covered the preceptor with arrows with a desire to withstand him.

sa: मुहूर्तमेव तद् युद्धमासीन्मधुरदर्शनम्। तत उन्मत्तवद राजन् निर्मर्यादमवर्तत॥
en: But that battle looked only for a while most excellent. Thereupon, monarch, the encounter look a very mad turn, in which all became regardless of one another.

sa: महीमालिङ्गय सर्वाङ्गैः पांसुध्वस्तशिरोरुहान्। पश्य योधान् महाबाहो त्वच्छरैर्भिन्नविग्रहान्॥
en: Clasping the earth with all their limbs and with their hair smeared with dust. Behold, O mighty-armed one, these warriors with their bodies mangled by your arrows.

sa: धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदीनामृषभोऽतिबलोदितः। त्वरितोऽभ्यद्रवद द्रोणं महेन्द्र इव शम्बरम्॥
en: Then again Dhristaketu that foremost among the Chedis, urged on by his great strength, quickly rushed against Kshemadhurti like the great Indra advancing upon the Asura Shambara.

sa: चतुर्भिः सारथिं चास्य चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्। तमाचार्यसिभिर्बाणैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: He wounded Drona's charioteer with four and his four steeds with another four arrows. The preceptor then pierced the right arm of his adversary with sixteen arrows.

sa: व्याघ्रसिंहगजाकीर्णानतिक्रम्य च पर्वतान्। वणिजाविव दृश्येतां हीनमृत्यू जरातिगौ॥
en: Beyond death and above the reach of decay, they then appeared like two tradesmen that have passed over a hilly district infested with tigers, lions and elephants.

sa: तथेतरान् महाराज यतमानान् महारथान्। पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिर्बाणैरेकैकं प्रत्यवारयत्॥
en: So also, O mighty monarch, he restrained cvery one of the other car-warriors, who were engaged in the contest, by means of five arrows shot at each.

sa: पदातीनां तु सहसा प्रदुतानां महाहवे। उत्सृज्याभरणं तूर्णमवप्लुत्य रणाजिरे॥ निमित्तं मन्यमानास्तु परिणाम्य महागजाः। जगृहुर्बिभिदुश्चैर चित्राण्याभरणानि॥
en: Many of the foot-soldiers, who were all on sudden running away in that dreadful battle, leaving behind their ornaments, immediately hemmed in upon the field. Then, indeed, the most powerful elephant-warriors, having considered the indications of victory, caused their elephants to take up those handsome ornaments and penetrate the fallen warriors with their tusks.

sa: तद् युद्धमासीत् तुमुलं प्रेक्षणीयं विशाम्पते। सिद्धचारणसंघानां विस्मयाद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: That awful fight, O ruler of men, indeed became a sight to look at; and Siddhas and Charanas, by thousands witnessed it with eyes expanded in wonder.

sa: तेषामन्तकरं युद्धं देहपाप्मासुनाशनम्॥ क्षत्रविट्शूद्रवीराणां धर्म्य स्वर्ग्य यशस्करम्।
en: That great battle, destructive of life, body and sins, brought on fame, virtue and heaven for all the Kshatriya, Vaishyas and Sudra heroes that engaged in it.

sa: दुःसहः पञ्चदशभिर्विव्याधोरसि सात्यकिम्। उत्स्मयन् वृष्णिशार्दूलस्तथा बाणैः समाहतः॥
en: Dussaha then pierced Satyaki on the centre of his chest with fifteen arrows. Then thus struck with those numerous shafts, that foremosi hero among the Vrishnis, smiled.

sa: स भीमसेनः शुशुभे तोमरै रङ्गमाश्रितैः। क्रोधदीप्तवपुर्मेधैः सप्तसप्तिरिवांशुमान्॥
en: That Bhimasena, whose form looked bright with rage, shone with those lances adhering to his body like the resplendent Sun with the masses of clouds about him.

sa: नवैते तव वाहिन्यामुच्छ्रिताः परमध्वजाः॥ व्यदीपयंस्ते पृतनां युगान्तादित्यसन्निभाः।
en: These nine excellent standards rose high amidst your troops and they lighted up your army, even like the suns that rise at the end of a Yuga.

sa: पिबनि शरौधांस्तान् द्रोणचापपरिच्युतान्। सोऽभ्यद्रवत सोदर्यान् मोहयन् बलमायया॥
en: Then seeming to drink in the arrowy showers shot from Drona's bow and confounding your troops by his illusive powers, he began to rush against your sons.

sa: भूयश्चान्यत् समादाय दिव्यमाङ्गिरसं धनुः। शरांश्च ब्रह्मदण्डाभान् धृष्टद्युम्नमयोधयत्॥
en: Then taking up another bow of celestial make, presented to him by Angiras and several arrows resembling the curses of Brahmanas, he went on fighting with Dhristadyumna.

sa: युध्यमानांस्तु तान् दूरान्मनुजेन्द्र प्रतापवान्॥ अष्टभिरष्टौ राधेयोऽभ्यर्दयनिशितैः शरैः।
en: But all those eight heroes who had proceeded to combat that brave hero, the son of Radha, were sorely afflicted by him each with eight piercing arrows.

sa: आपतत्सु रथौधेषु प्रभूतगजवाजिषु। नासम्भ्रमत् तदा पार्थस्तदस्य पुरुषानति॥
en: Though myriads of chariots and thousands upon thousands of elephants and steeds assailed him, yet Partha experienced no fear; but every moment obtained advantages over his enemies.

sa: हत्वा कर्णसुतं भीमस्तावकान् पुनरार्दयत्। कृपहार्दिक्ययोश्छित्त्वा चापौ तावप्यथार्दयत्॥
en: Having killed Karna's son Bhima began to assail your army once more; sundering the bows of Kripa and Hridika's son he began to assail those two heroes.

sa: रथेनादित्यवपुषा भीमः प्रहरतां वरः। किरञ्छरौघान् प्रययावलायुधरथं प्रति॥
en: That foremost of all smiters, viz., Bhimasena, rushed against the chariot of Alayudha, riding on his own car of solar effulgence and shooting showers of sharp arrows.

sa: सुवर्णपुङ्खरिषुभिराचितौ तौ व्यराजताम्। खद्योतैरावृतौ राजन् प्रावृषीव वनस्पती॥
en: Pierced with shafts endued with golden wings, those two (heroes), O monarch, looked as (beautiful) two lords of the forest covered with glow-worms during the rainy season.

sa: पश्यतस्तव पुत्रस्य कर्णस्य च महात्मनः। ग्रस्तमाचार्यमुख्येन धृष्टद्युम्नममोचयत्॥
en: Before the eyes of your son and of Karna of high-soul, he then thus saved Dhristadyumna who was on the point of falling a victim to Drona.

sa: तत्रैकोऽस्रबलश्लाघी द्रौणिर्मानी च विव्यथे। व्यधमच शरैर्मायां घटोत्कचविनिर्मिताम्॥
en: There the haughty son, of Drona only proud of his prowess in weapons, stood without fear (and he) soon did away with the illusion created by Ghatotkacha.

sa: यत्प्राविशन्महेष्वासः पञ्चालानपराजितः। नृत्यन् स रथमार्गेषु सर्वशस्रभृतां वरः॥
en: When that unvanquished and mighty wielder of bow and that foremost of the wielders of weapons, dancing on the track of his car, entered among the Panchalas.

sa: ववुर्वाताः सनिर्घातास्रासयाना वरूथिनीम्। पपात महती चोल्का आदित्यानिश्चरन्त्युत॥
en: Fierce winds began to blow filling the troops of the enemy with fear. Mighty meteors began to drop down, seeming to issue out of the solar disc.

sa: तौ परस्परमासाद्य शरवर्षेण पार्थिव॥ छादयेतां महेष्वासौ कृतप्रतिकृतैषिणौ।
en: Those two mighty wielders of bow desiring to baffle each other and coming up to catch each other enveloped each other with a (perfect) deluge of arrows.

sa: भीष्ममप्रतियुद्ध्यन्तं शिखण्डी सायकोत्तमैः। पातयामास समरे सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्॥
en: Shikhandin slew in battle, by means of the best of his darts, that great wielder of all weapons, Bhishma, who did not care for repelling the foes.

sa: अलम्बुषो राक्षसेन्द्र खरबन्धुरयानवान्। घटोत्कचेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम्॥
en: Alambusha the lord of the Rakshasas who had a chariot drawn by arms, was sent to the abode of Yama by Ghatotkacha displaying his prowess in battle.

sa: तांस्तु द्रोणविनिर्मुक्तान् क्रुद्धाशीविषसंनिभान्। एकैकं पञ्चभिर्बाणैयुद्धि चिच्छेद हृष्टवत्॥
en: Then Vrihadkshatra cheerful cut-off each of those arrows shot by Drona and looking like so many enraged snakes of virulent poison, with five shafts of his own.

sa: समाजमिव तचित्रं प्रेक्षमाणा महारथाः। नालक्षयञ्जय व्यक्तमेकस्यैव महारणे॥
en: Your warriors, who were then looking upon that battle as upon a sport in an arena could not find any of them get any advantage over other.

sa: सकुण्डलयुगान् कर्णान् केषांचिदहरज्छरैः। सतोमरान् गजस्थानां सप्रासान् हयसादिनाम्॥
en: And ears graced with pairs of ear-rings, of his enemies, Pritha's son cut-off with his shafts. The arms of elephant-riders, with Tomaras; those of horsemen, with Prasas;

sa: ततः शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तानरीश्वेतवाहनः। प्रत्यषेधद् द्रुतं क्रुद्धो महावातो घनानिव॥
en: Thereat Dhananjaya owning white seeds and burning with rage, mangled those enemies of his with hundreds of shafts, like a raging tempest tearing away masses of clouds.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय प्राविध्यत युधिष्ठिरम्। तावन्योन्यं सुसंक्रुद्धौ शस्त्रवर्षाण्यमुञ्चताम्॥
en: Then, having taken up another bow, he (Duryodhana) pierced the son of Pandu in return. Those two heroic warriors, poured forth showers of arrows upon each other.

sa: दीप्तोग्रसम्भृतशरः किरीट विरराज ह। वर्षास्विवोदीर्णजल: सेन्द्रधन्वाम्बुदो महान्॥
en: The diadem-decked Arjuna, armed with arrows of glittering tips shone resplendent like a mighty mass of cloud swelling with rain and bearing the rainbow on its bosom.

sa: व्यश्वसूतरथांश्चक्रे कुमारान् कुपितो रणे। अथापरैः सुनिशितैर्भल्लैस्तेषां महायशाः॥
en: Inflamed as he was with rage, deprived those princes of their chariots, charioteers and steeds. Thereafter that hero of world-wide fame, with his sharp arrows and Vallas.

sa: इत्युक्तो देवदेवाभ्यां सहस्राक्षोऽब्रवीद् वचः। आमन्त्र्य सर्वभूतानि ब्रोशानानुशासनम्॥
en: When those two greatest of Gods (Brahma and Ishana) said so the God with thousand eyes respectfully bowed to their words and himself said to other creatures.

sa: वामपादे तु राजेन्द्र कृतवर्मा व्यवस्थितः। नारायणबलैर्युक्तो गोपालैर्युद्धदुर्मदैः॥
en: O lord of kings, Kritavarman was placed in the left foot, who was attended by the Narayana-army, namely the Gopalas, most difficult to be vanquished in battle.

sa: स पञ्चनदमासाद्य धीमानतिसमृद्धिमत्। देशे गोपशुधान्याढ्ये निवासमकरोत् प्रभुः॥
en: Arrived at the country of the five waters, the powerful Dhananjaya encamped in the midst of a land that abounded with corn and kine and other animals.

sa: ततस्त्रिविनतं चापमादायात्मविभूषणम्। आबध्य च कपालौ द्वौ जगामोदग्रविक्रमः॥
en: And girding himself with his bow bent at three places, which served him ornament,—as well as a couple of quivers, that one of fierce energy sallied out.

sa: षष्टिर्गिरिसहस्राणि रम्याः काञ्चनपर्वताः॥ तेषां मध्ये गिरिवरस्त्वमिवानघ रक्षसाम्।
en: There are sixty thousand charming Golden hills. In their midst is that best of mountains,* even as you, O sinless one, are among the Raksasa. *Savarni Meru.

sa: मृद्यमानाश्च दृश्यन्ते पार्थेन नरयूथपाः। इषुभिस्ताङ्यमानाश्च नाराचैश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: The leaders of hosts of combatants were then seen to be crushed and mangled by the son of Pritha with his arrows and lances shot by thousands.

sa: दंशिताः क्रूरकर्माणः काम्बोजा युद्धदुर्मदाः। शरबाणासनधरा यवनाश्च प्रहारिणः॥
en: And yonder Kambojas of dreadful deeds, cased in mail and difficult of defeat in battle and these Yavanas armed with bows and arrows and accomplished in smiting.

sa: यथोक्तं जामदग्न्येन भूयानेष ततोऽर्जुनः। कृष्णो हि देवकीपुत्रो देवैरपि सुदुःसहः। किं ते सुखप्रियेणेह प्रोक्तेन भरतर्षभ॥
en: Arjuna is still mightier than what the son of Jamadagni has described him to be; Krishna, the son of Devaki, is hard to vanquished even by gods, O best among the Bharatas, what is the use of telling you what is conducive to your happiness and ought therefore to be desired for by you.

sa: तत्कारणैर्हि संयुक्त कार्यसंग्रहकारकम्। येनैतद् वर्तते चक्रमनादिनिधनं महत्॥
en: The Soul, when it becomes endued with desires, engages in acts. On account of that condition, this vast wheel of existence revolves with beginning and without end.

sa: गुरुं भारं समासाद्यड्डीन एष विहंगमः। गरुडस्तु खगश्रेष्ठस्तस्मात्पन्नगभोजनः॥
en: They said "As this great bird rises on its wings with a heavy burden, let the best of the birds, the eater of snakes, be called Garuda.”

sa: नमस्तेऽस्तु हृषीकेश महापुरुषपूर्वज॥ इति शब्दः श्रुतोऽस्माभिः शिक्षाक्षरसमन्वितः।
en: Salutation to you, O Hrishikesha, O foremost of Beings, O First-born! This was the sound we heard, uttered distinctly and in accordance with the rules of orthoepy.

sa: सोऽहमैश्वर्यमोहेन मदाविष्टो युधिष्ठिर। पतितः प्रतिसम्बुद्धस्त्वां तु सम्बोधयाम्यहम्॥
en: So, O Yudhishthira, I too, intoxicated with the drink of prosperity, have fallen into this degraded state and then having recovered my reason am addressed you thus.

sa: एतस्य रथवंशे हि तिग्मवेगप्रहारिणः। काम्बोजानां महाराज शलभानामिवायतिः॥
en: The best of car warriors under him are strikers with fierce force. The Kambojas, o great king, will cover like the land like a swarm of locusts.

sa: प्रविष्टमात्रे ज्ञातोऽहं बले तस्मिन्विचारिते। बलादृहीतो रक्षोभिर्बहुधास्मि विचारितः॥
en: As soon as I entered, and was scanning that host, I was discovered. And forcibly taken by the Rākşasa, I was pulled by them hither and thither.

sa: तं यान्तं पृष्ठगोप्तारमर्जुनस्य विशाम्पते। चारणा: प्रेक्ष्य संहृष्टास्त्वदीयाश्चाभ्यपूजयन्॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, beholding him proceeding as the rear-guard of Arjuna, the Charanas were filled with delight. Even your troops then began to applaud him.

sa: परिणीय च सर्वत्र नीतोऽहं रामसंसदि। रुधिरस्राविदीनाङ्गो विह्वलश्चलितेन्द्रियः॥
en: And, after having been taken all about, I was (at length) taken before Rāma, bleeding, with my limbs showing sorry work, and my senses swimming and paralysed.

sa: अथ हर्म्यतलस्थाहं रविमुद्यन्तमीक्षती। संस्मृत्य तदृषेर्वाक्यं स्पृहयन्ती दिवानिशम्॥
en: One day, sitting with my chamber I saw the sun rising. Desiring to bring the maker of day before me, I recollected the words of the Rishi.

sa: दस्यूना सशिरस्त्राणैः शिरोभिनमूर्धजैः। :।।४ दीर्घकूचैर्मही कीर्णा विबहरण्डजैरिव।
en: The ground was then strewn over with the head-gears of those robbers and the shaved heads that looked like unfledged birds in consequence of their long beards.

sa: तत्रासीनः शुकस्तात मोक्षमेवान्वचिन्तयत्॥ छायायामातपे चैव समदर्शी महाद्युतिः।
en: Seated there, Shuka, O son, began to think of Liberation only. Gifted with equality he considered impartially a shaded spot and one exposed to the Sun's rays.

sa: अगम्यरूपा पृधिवा यशाणातकर्दमाम्॥ कृतवांस्तत्र शैनयः क्षपयंस्तावकं बलम्।
en: The carth became impassable; and it was slippery with the flesh and blond that then constitutcoins mire. The grandson of Sini then cabut carnage amous pour troops.

sa: नान्तर्धाने न संयुक्ते न च तिर्यक् कदाचन॥ न चापि गच्छेत् कार्येण समयाद् वापि नास्तिकैः।
en: One should not sleep on a bed without having examined it first with the help of a light. Nor should one sleep on a bed with another by his side. One should never sleep in a transverse direction. One should never make agreement with atheists or do anything in conjunction with them. an one

sa: तदवस्थं तु भरतं शत्रुघ्नोऽनन्तरस्थितः। परिष्वज्य रुरोदोच्चैर्विसंज्ञः शोककर्शितः॥
en: Seeing Bharata in that condition, ſatrughna who was near, taking the former on his lap, began to cry, almost deprived of his senses and oppressed with grief.

sa: तं यान्तं पृष्ठगोप्तारमर्जुनस्य विशाम्पते। चारणा: प्रेक्ष्य संहृष्टास्त्वदीयाश्चाभ्यपूजयन्॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, beholding him proceeding as the rear-guard of Arjuna, the Charanas were filled with delight. Even your troops then began to applaud him.

sa: सुदर्शनो नाम महाञ्जम्बूवृक्षः सनातनः॥ सर्वकामफलः पुण्यः सिद्धचारणसेवितः।
en: There is a very large Jambu tree by name of Sudarshana which is eternal. When adorned by the Siddhas and Charanas, that sacred tree grants every desire.

sa: तांश्चातिभग्नान् सम्प्रेक्ष्य पुत्रो दुःशासनस्तव। पाषाणयोधिनः शूरान् पर्वतीयानचोदयत्॥
en: Urged on the heroic mountaineers skilled in fighting with stones saying-"You are all skillful in fighting. The Kauravas also are all ignorant of this mode of war-fare.

sa: दुर्योधनसहायाश्च राक्षसाः परिकीर्तिताः। प्राप्तास्ते क्रमशो राजन् सर्वलोकाननुत्तमान्॥
en: Those who had fought on the side of Duryodhana are said to have been Rakshasas. Gradually, o king, they have all attained to excellent regions of happiness.

sa: एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैरुपरुध्य मुहुर्मुहुः। राजानं दुःखसंतप्तः सुतं तमुपगृहति॥
en: Being overwhelmed with sorrow that old Brāhmaṇa again and again remonstrated with the king in these 'piteous words and afterwards covered the dead body (of his son.)

sa: कर्मदायादवाँल्लोकः कर्मसम्बन्धलक्षणः। कर्माणि चोदयन्तीह यथान्योन्यं तथा वयम्॥
en: Karma is a help to salvation as sons are and Karma also expresses virtue and vice in man. We impell one another even acts urge one another.

sa: अकुण्डलधराश्चान्या विच्छन्नमृदितस्रजः। गजेन्द्रमृदिताः फुल्ला लता इव महावने॥
en: And others again were without their ear-rings, and had their garlands torn and crushed; and resembled blossoming creepers, trodden down in a vast forest by mighty elephants.

sa: कथमिन्दीवरश्यामं दीर्घबाहुं महाबलम्। अभिराममहं रामं स्थापयिष्यामि दण्डकान्॥
en: How shall I dismiss to Dandaka the charming Rāma of dark blue hue like that of a blue lotus, possessed of mighty arms, and having great strength?

sa: काशीश्वरस्य तीर्थेषु स्नात्वा भरतसत्तम। सर्वव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, bathing in the Tirtha of Kashishvara, one is freed from all diseases; and he is adored in the region of Brahma.

sa: विदितास्तव धर्मज्ञ देवदानवराक्षसाः। राजवंशाश्च विविधा ऋषिवंशाश्च शाश्वतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O virtuous one, you know all the celestials and the Danavas, the Rakshasas, also various royal dynasties and many everlasting dynasties of the Rishis.

sa: बृहस्पति देवपतिरभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः। उपसंगम्य पप्रच्छ वासवः परवीरहा।॥
en: Once on a time, that destroyer of hostile heroes, viz., Vasava, the king of the gods, joining his hands, approached Brihaspati, and saluting him, said these words.

sa: मिथ्योपचरितास्तात जन्मप्रभृति बान्धवाः। त्वयि सम्यङ्महाबाहो प्रतिपन्ना यशस्विनः॥
en: O friend, ever since birth the sons of Pandu have been treated with deception but those renowned men, O you of long arms, have treated you generously.

sa: तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ राजपुत्रौ परंतपौ॥ त्वदर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः।
en: And those two princes, the foremost of men and slayers of foes, actuated with energy on hearing that I have seen you, shall reduce Lankā to ashes.

sa: अर्चितस्तैर्यथान्यायं संवत्सरमथोषितः। स्वपुरानिर्विशेषं च प्रियं प्राप्तो दशाननः॥
en: And duly honoured (by then) Daśānana passed there a year, without any feeling of that place being different from his own home: and spent his time agreeably.

sa: तैरासीद्गगनं दीप्तं संपतद्भिः समन्ततः। पतद्भिश्च दिशो दीप्तैश्चन्द्रसूर्ग्रहैरिव।।।।
en: The firmament all round blazed up with those impendent (arms) as blaze up the cardinal quarters on the Sun and the Moon and the planets dropping down.

sa: समुत्पेतुरथोत्पाता दारुणा रोमहर्षणाः। रावणस्य विनाशाय राघवस्योदयाय च॥
en: For the destruction of Råvana and the success of Rāghava, there occurred round about the cars terrible bodements capable of making people's down stand on end. as

sa: पूर्वाणे धर्मकार्याणि कृत्वा धर्मेण धर्मवित्। शेष दिवसभागार्धमन्त:पुरगतोऽभवत्॥
en: Once on a morning time, having performed all the religious ceremonies, in the fore part of the day, Rāma, to spend the evening, entered the inner apartment.

sa: इत्युक्त्वोत्थाय तं क्षिप्रं बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपत्तले। कन्दुवत्स समुत्थाय बाहुभ्यामाक्षिपद्धरिः॥
en: Having said this, be rose up swiftly and dragged him down to the earth. Thereat springing like pith, the monkey pushed down his antagonist with his arms.

sa: काचिदाडम्बरं नारी भुजसम्भोगपीडितम्। कृत्वा कमलपत्राक्षी प्रसुप्ता मदमोहिता॥
en: Another damsel having eyes resembling lotuspetals, having come under the influence of liquor, was asleep, firmly holding her aramvara' with her hands. A kind of musical instrument.

sa: दूषयेयुर्दुरात्मानः पथि मूलफलोदकम्। राक्षसाः पथि रक्षेथास्तेभ्यस्त्वं नित्यमुद्यतः॥
en: The wicked Raksasas vitiate* fruits, roots and water along the way. You, ever not the alert, should preserve these from the Rākṣasa. *By means of poison, etc.

sa: सागरौघनिभं भीममग्रानीकं महाबलाः। कपिसिंहाः प्रकर्षन्तु शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Therefore let the foremost monkeys gifted with prodigious prowess lead forth like a host of terrible ocean, the choice portion of the army, numbering hundreds and thousands.

sa: वानरेन्द्रश्च बलवानृक्षराजश्च वीर्यवान्। राक्षसेन्द्रानुनश्चैव गुल्मे भवतु मध्यमे॥
en: And let the powerful king of monkeys, and the puissant sovereign of bears, and the younger brother of the Raksasa-chief, manage the soldiery posted in the centre.

sa: एवमुक्ता हनुमता वैदेही जनकात्मजा। साब्रवीद्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं भक्तवत्सलम्॥
en: Being thus accosted by Hanumān, Vaidehi, the daughter of king Janaka, said, “I wish to see my lord, ever fond of those who are devoted to him."

sa: फ्लैश्चतुर्भिः स तु तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैः। रथं समायुक्तमसह्यवेगः समारुरोहेन्द्रजिदिन्द्रकल्पः॥
en: Thereupon Indrajit of unbearable prowess, equal to the lord of the celestials, ascended a car drawn by four horses, having sharpened teeth and resembling Garuda in velocity.

sa: शूलोऽयं वज्रसारस्ते राम रोषान्मयोद्यतः। तव भ्रातृसहायस्य सम्यक्प्राणान्हरिष्यति॥
en: O Rāma, I in wrath uplift this dart having the strength of the levin. This will utterly deprive of life you who are assisted by your brother.

sa: शङ्खभेरीसहस्राणामाहतानां समन्ततः। क्ष्वेलितास्फोटितानां च तत्र शब्दो महानभूत्॥
en: There arose a terrible noise on all sides from the sound of conches, and thousands of bugles, and from the moving of the arms of the heroes.

sa: अद्य बाणैर्धनुर्मुक्तैर्युगान्तादित्यसंनिभैः। राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव नेष्यामि यमसादनम्॥
en: Today shall I despatch both Rāma and Lakşmaņa to the abode of Death with arrows resembling the sun at the time of dissolution, discharged off my bow.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम विस्तीर्णबलवाहनः। प्रेषितो न्यपतद्यक्षो नाम्ना संयोधकण्टकः॥
en: In the meantime, o Rāma, a Yakşa named Sañyodhakanțaka, accompanied by an extensive force and a large number of vehicles, on being despatched, rushed (on the foe).

sa: ततः पक्षिनिनादेन वृक्षभङ्गस्वनेन च। बभूवुस्वाससम्भ्रान्ताः सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः॥
en: Then on account of the cries of birds and the sounds of breaking trees, all the denizons of Lankā were seized with trepidation in consequence of fright.

sa: ते मुक्तकेशाः संभ्रान्ता भग्नमानाः पराजिताः। भयाच्छ्रमजलैरङ्गैः प्रस्रवद्भिर्विदुद्रुवुः॥
en: And with their hair flowing loosely, (the Rāks asas), afflicted with affright, and dispirited and beaten, fled fast, with the water of fatigue running down their persons.

sa: एतानिहत्यातिबलान्बहूराक्षससत्तमान्। बाहुभ्यां सागरं तीर्खा लङ्घयतां गोष्पदं लघु।।१५
en: Having slain these many powerful Rākşasas endowed with excess of might, having crossed the sea with your arms, do you cross this foot print of a cow.

sa: ते हृष्टवदनाः सर्वे जग्मुर्मारुतरंहसः॥ हरयो राघवस्यार्थे समारोपितविक्रमाः।
en: They were all of delighted countenances and gifted with the velocity of the wind. And these monkeys devoted all their energy to the accomplishment of Rāghava's work.

sa: स रोषाद्रक्तनयनो राक्षसेन्द्रो बलोद्धतः॥ इत्येवमर्जुनामात्यानाह गम्भीरया गिरा।
en: At the very sight the eyes of the lord of Raksasas, proud of his prowess, grew red and addressing the councillors of the king Arjuna he said.

sa: शाकतुम्भनिभाः केचित् केचिदग्निशिखप्रभाः॥ नीलाञ्जननिभाः केचित् तत्राशोकाः सहस्रशः।
en: And there was a thousand of Asoka trees, some of whom were like gold, some were like the flame of fire and some were like dark-blue collyrium.

sa: त्वत्सकाशान्महाबाहो संस्कारं विधिपूर्वकम्॥ क्षिप्रमर्हति धर्मेण त्वं यशोभाग्भविष्यसि।
en: O you of long-arms it behove the to perform speedily with due rites and religious ceremonies his funeral ceremony-you shall be the object of praise (to people).

sa: मारुतः सुखसंस्पर्शो वाचि चन्दनशीतलः। षट्पदैरनुकूजद्भिर्वनेषु मधुगन्धिषु ॥
en: There blew in those forests filled with the smell of honey, a wind of pleasant touch, cool as the Moon, accompanied by the hummings of the bees.

sa: प्रापिताविषुजालेन राघवौ कङ्कपत्रिणा। एष रोषपरीतात्मा नयामि यमसादनम्॥
en: And I, with my soul surcharged with wrath, shall, assailing them with showers of weapons furnished with Karka feathers, send Raghu's sons to the abode of Yama."

sa: वैधव्यं यान्ति यैर्नार्योऽलक्षणैर्भाग्यदुर्लभाः। नात्मनस्तानि पश्यामि पश्यन्ती हतलक्षणा।७।।
en: Those marks find I none on me by which women of rare fortune come by widowhood, but I find that in me these good tokens are nullified.

sa: त्यक्तधर्मव्रतं क्रूरं नृशंसमनृतं तथा।१३।। नाहमर्हामि संस्कर्तुं परदाराभिमर्शनम्।
en: "I do not think it proper to perform his cremation ceremony who had renounced all pious deeds was wicked cruel, liar and who had ravished others' wives.

sa: तद्वियोगेन्धनवता तच्चिन्ताविमलार्चिषा। रात्रिंदिवं शरीरं मे दह्यते मदनाग्निा॥
en: I am now being burnt down day and night by the fire of desire, having separation from her for its fuel and her thoughts for its flame.

sa: सर्वेषां समतिक्रम्य भवनानि समन्ततः। आससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान् राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम्॥
en: Having bounded over the mansions of all situated around, that blessed with one auspiciousness, at length came to the very mansion of the monarch of the Rākşasas.

sa: पूर्णचन्द्राननां सुद्धू चारुवृत्तपयोधराम्॥ कुर्वती प्रभया देवी सर्वा वितिमिरा दिशः। तां नीलकण्ठी बिम्बोष्ठी सुमध्यां सुप्रतिष्ठिताम्॥
en: Having the countenance of the full-moon, beautiful eye brows, round breast, she is as if dispelling the darkness from all quarters by virtue of her grace. Her throat was yellow, and her lips were like Bimbas.* She was of middle stature and her limbs were all well built. *A circubituceous plant with red fruits.

sa: राक्षसानां बलौघस्य वानरेन्द्रबलस्य च। नैतयोविद्यते संधिदेवदानवयोरिव ॥
en: And peace there can be none between the forces of the Rákşasas and the hosts of the sovereign of monkeys, like to the deities and the Danavas.

sa: कदा शोणितदिग्धाङ्गं दीप्तैः कार्मुकविच्युतैः। शरैरादीपयिष्यामि उल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: When by means of flaming shafts shot from my bow shall I burn (Rāghava) with his body bathed in blood, even as a meteor (burn) an elephant?

sa: अथवा नायमुन्मादो मोहोऽप्युन्मादलक्षणः। सम्बुध्ये चाहमात्मानमिमं चापि वनौकसम्॥
en: No, it is not madness-for derangement of mind is the sign of madness, I have not lost sense and I do distinctly perceive me and the monkey.

sa: एवमुक्तास्ततस्तेन तस्यामात्याः समाहताः। मारीचप्रमुखाः सर्वे विमुखा विप्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: Honest people should act carefully in connection with the wicked.' Thus reprimanded by him, his (Rāvana's) councillors, headed by Marica, on being struck, took to their heels.

sa: आयुष्यमारोग्यकरं यशस्यं सौभ्रातृकं बुद्धिकरं शुभं च। राख्यानमोजस्करमृद्धिकामैः॥
en: They attain to long life, health, fame, intellect, prowess, and good brothers. Therefore it behove those good men, who wish for prosperity, to hear this story perpetually.

sa: पञ्चाला: केकया मत्स्याः संजयाश्च विशाम्पते। सर्वोद्योगेनाभिजग्मुर्दोणमेव युयुत्सया॥
en: And hastened with all speed to the place where Vrikodara, the son of Pritha was. Then, the Panchalas, the Srinjayas, the Matsyas as well as the Keykeyas.

sa: अन्योन्यागस्कृतां राजन् यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्। मुहूर्तास्तमिते सूर्ये चक्रुर्युद्धं सुदारुणम्॥
en: Out of a feeling of animosity, they fought the dreadful fight that lasted for a few moments only before sun-set, adding to the population of Death's kingdom,

sa: यदाऽऽयाज्जलदप्रख्यो रथः परमवीर्यवान्। पर्जन्य इव वीभत्सुस्तुमुलामशनीं सृजन्॥
en: As that mighty car-warrior of excessive energy, Vibhatsu, resembling a dense mass of rain-clouds, came, creating terrible sounds like the clappings of the thunder-bolt, like Parjanya itself.

sa: तांश्चैव सर्वान्स हरीशरैः सर्वायसैबली। विव्याधाभिमुखान्संख्ये भीमकायो विशारदः॥
en: In that encounter that powerful one possessed of a gigantic person, skilled in arms, pierced all those monkeys staying before him with arrows entirely made of iron.

sa: अश्वाञ्जाम्बूनदैर्जालैः प्रच्छन्नान् वातरंहसः। जघान् षड्भिरासाद्य सारथिं चाभ्यपातयत्॥
en: Advancing closer, with six arrows he pierced Shrutakarman's steedscaparisoned with a net work of gold and fleet as the wind itself; he also felled the letters charioteer.

sa: तं हृष्टास्तावका राजन् स्थपत्तिसमन्विताः। गजाश्वसादिबहुलाः पाण्डवं समुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Seeing Pandu's sun so advance, O king, your warriors, with a long line of cars and a retinue of elephant, horse and foot soldiers, pressed upon him.

sa: अगर्हणीयो न च गर्हतेऽनयान्स वै विप्रः परमात्मानमीक्षेत्। विनीतमोहो व्यपनीतकल्मषो न चेह नामुत्र च सोऽन्नमृच्छति॥
en: He who never does anything blameable and who never censures another, is said to be a truly twice-born one. Such a man succeeds in seeing the Supreme Soul. He whose ignorance has been removed and whose sins have been washed away, never enjoys either here or hereafter the happiness that is enjoyed by others.

sa: दुर्योधनश्च महता शरवर्षेण माधवम्। अपीडयद्रणे राजशूराश्चान्ये महारथाः॥
en: Then with a mighty shower of arrows Duryodhana, O king, afflicted that mighty carwarrior the descendant of Madhu's race. O king, other heroic warriors followed his example.

sa: नामृष्यत रणे राजा शत्रोविजयलक्षणम्। अथान्यद्धनुरादाय हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्॥-
en: m In that battle, he could not bear this sign of the success of his enemy. Then taking up another bow of great toughness and golden staff.

sa: इदं निर्दिष्टमयशः पुरोचनकृतं महत्। तेषामनुग्रहेणाद्य राजन् प्रक्षालयात्मनः॥
en: O king, the stain of calumny is on you on account of the act of Purochana. Wash yourself off it by kindly behaving towards them (the Pandavas).

sa: द्रवद्भिस्तत्र राजेन्द्र कृतः शब्दोऽतिदारुणः॥ क्षुब्धसागरसंकाशा: क्षुभिताः सर्वतोऽभवन्।
en: O monarch, the noise made by those rushing warriors was terrible and resembled that of the agitated ocean. Thereat the field of battle was agitated all around.

sa: तथैवाप्रतिबुद्धोऽपि विज्ञेयो नृपसत्तम। प्रकृतेस्त्रिगुणायास्तु सेवनात् त्रिगुणो भवेत्॥
en: Though, O king, free from error of every sort, yet on account of its devotion to the three qualities of Nature, it becomes endued with those attributes.

sa: दीप्यमानेन वपुषा रथेनादित्यवर्चसा। तादृशेनैव राजेन्द्र यादृशेन घटोत्कचः॥
en: His person was effulgent and his chariot burnt with the splendour of the solar disc. Indeed, O foremost of kings, he looked as beautiful as Ghatotkacha himself.

sa: तत आचार्यपाञ्चाल्यौ युयुधाते महाबलौ। विक्षोभयन्तौ तत् सैन्यमिन्द्रवैरोचनाविव॥
en: Then the war-like Acharya and the prince of the Panchalas fought with one another, agitating the armies hostile to each, like Indra and the son of Virochana.

sa: कुलमाञ्जनकं नाम यत्रैते वीर्यशलिनः। आस्थिता बहुभिर्लेच्छैर्युद्धशौण्डैः प्रहारिभिः॥
en: All belonging to the breed known as Arjuna and all possessed of great prowess and ridden by numerous Mlechchas delighting in battle and skilled in smiting down.

sa: यदहर्ब्रह्मणः प्रोक्तं सहस्रयुगसम्मितम्। तस्य त्वमादिरन्तश्च कालज्ञैः परिकीर्तितः॥
en: Those that know all about the Time say that you are the beginning and the end of the Brahma day which consists of full one thousand Yugas.

sa: समाचिनोद् राक्षसेन्द्रं घटोत्कचमरिंदमम्। स शरैराचितस्तेन राक्षसो रणमूर्धनि॥
en: (He) pierced the subduer of foes, that is Ghatotkacha, the lord of the Rakshasas. The Rakshasa, thus pierced with shafts by him on the field of battle.

sa: जगद् विनिर्दहेदेवमल्पतेजसि पातितम्। पीड्यमानेन बलवत् प्रयोज्यं स्याद्धनंजय॥
en: If hurled at a being of small energy it will burn up the universe. This powerful weapon can be discharged only when you will be hard pressed.

sa: आजघानेन्द्रजित्क्रुद्धो वज्रेणेव शतक्रतुः। अङ्गदं गदया वीरं शत्रुसैन्यविदारणम्॥
en: Indrajit, growing enraged, with his mace dealt a blow at that tearer of hostile ranks, angada, like him of an hundred sacrifices striking with his · thunderbolt.

sa: निघ्नन् प्रोथेन पृथिवीं विलिखंचरणैरपि। सम्मार्जञ्जठरेणोर्वी विवर्तश्च मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Ploughing the earth with his mouth, striking (it) with his feet, rubbing the ground with his belly and roving constantly to and fro in a frightful manner.

sa: आधिपत्यं व्रजेन्मयो ज्येष्ठायामपवर्जयन्। नरः कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ ऋद्धो दमपुरःसरः॥
en: By making offerings in honour of the departed Manes Manes under the constellation Jeshthya, with devotion and humility, one acquires sovereignty, O foremost one of Kuru's race.

sa: ऋषिरासीन्महान्पूर्वं तयोविद्यासमन्वितः। स्थूलकेश इति ख्यातः सर्वभूतहिते रतः॥
en: In the days of yore, there was a Rishi, named Sthulakesha, who was possessed of ascetic powers and learning and engaged in doing good to all creatures.

sa: गाङ्गेयो रथिनां श्रेष्ठः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्। व्यधमन्निशितैर्बाणैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: That foremost of car-warriors viz., the son of Ganga began to consume the ranks of the Pandava host, with his sharp shafts discharged by hundreds and thousands.

sa: विशालायतताम्राक्षैः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननैः। एषा भूः कीर्यते राज्ञां शिरोभिरपलायिनाम्॥
en: The earth is strewn with the heads of the kings who never come back from the battlefield, having expansive coppery eyes and faces like the full moon.

sa: संक्रुद्धोऽतिबलः संख्ये शस्त्रमादाय वीर्यवान्। जनिवान् कार्तवीर्यस्य सुतानेकोऽन्तकोपमः॥
en: That mighty hero, greatly powerful in battle, equal to god of death himself, then took up weapons in anger; and alone he killed the sons of Kirtavirya.

sa: पूर्ण वर्षसहस्रं च एवंवृत्तिरभूनृपः। अब्भक्षः शरदस्त्रिंशदासीनियतवाङ्गनाः॥ ततश्च वायुभक्षोऽभूत् संवत्सरमतन्द्रितः। तथा पञ्चाग्निमध्ये च तपस्तेपे स वत्सरम्॥ एकपादः स्थितश्चासीत् षण्मासाननिलाशनः। पुण्यकीर्तिस्ततः स्वर्गे जगामावृत्य रोदसी॥
en: The king thus passed full one thousand years. He passed thirty years, living on water only and observed the vow of silence with mind under complete control. He passed full one year in fasting, living on air alone and having no sleep. He passed another one year in the midst of four fires and the burning sun overhead. He stood for six months continually on one leg. (Having thus passed his life in austere penances), the king, (Yayati) the doer of sacred deeds, ascended heaven.

sa: ऋषयश्च महाघोरान् दृष्ट्वोत्पातान् समन्ततः। अकुर्वञ्छान्तिमुद्विग्ना लोकानां लोकभावनाः॥
en: The Rishis who always sought the welfare of the world, seeing these fearful omens on all sides, began with anxious hearts to restore tranquility in the universe.

sa: तामापतन्ती सहसा सहदेवप्रचोदिताम्। व्यष्टम्भयच्छरैः कर्णो भूमौ चैनामपातयत्॥
en: Karna, however, cut-off with shafts that mace which, hurled by the Shahadeva, was making for him with great force and caused it to fall on the ground.

sa: काश्चिदग्निपरीताङ्गयो हर्येभ्यो मुक्तमूर्धजाः॥ पतन्त्यो रेजिरेऽभ्रेभ्यः सौदामन्य इवाम्बरात्।
en: And some fair ones with hair dishevelled, and surrounded on all sides with fire, as they fell down from dwellings, looked lovely like lightning from the welkin.

sa: पुनरेष्यति देवानामिन्द्रत्वमकुतोभयः। स्वकर्मभिश्च नहुषो नाशं यास्यति दुर्मतिः॥
en: Regain the position of the king of the gods without any fear. And the evil-minded Nahusha will meet with destruction, as the effect of his own deeds.

sa: मानुषान् कामभोगांस्त्वमैश्वर्यं च प्रशंससि। अभोगिनोऽबलाश्चैव यान्ति स्थानमनुत्तमम्॥७॥
en: You speak highly of your worldly desires and enjoyinents and prosperity. But those who have renounced all enjoyments and reduced their bodies by penances obtain blissful regions.

sa: एतस्मिन् वर्तमानस्य विधावप्रतिषेधिते। त्यागिनः प्रसृतस्येह नोच्छित्तिर्विद्यते क्वचित्॥
en: The Renouncer that rigidly follows this mode of life, in which one is free to do all acts, has not to meet ruin either here or hereafter.

sa: तेऽभ्ययुः समरे राजन् वासुदेवधनंजयौ। द्रोणसृष्टाः सुबहवः कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छदाः॥
en: Those numerous arrows furnished with wings of Kanka feather and discharged by Drona in that battle, incessantly fell, O monarch, on Dhananjaya and the son of Vasudeva.

sa: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान् संसारेषु नराधमान्। क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु॥
en: These cruel heaters of Me, these sinful, vilest men among men, are hurled continually down by Me into demoniac wombs (to be demoniac in their next births).

sa: द्रोणमुत्सृज्य गच्छामः कृत्यमेतन्महत्तरम्। पार्थश्चाप्यब्रवीत् कृष्णं यथेष्टमिति केशवम्॥
en: Let us proceed leaving Drona alone the more important task must be accomplished.” Then the son of Pritha replied to Krishna saying-"As it lists you, O Keshava."

sa: अद्य विप्रसरिष्यन्ति राक्षस्यो हतबान्धवाः। वाष्पार्द्रवदना दीना भयादन्यभयावहाः॥
en: Today Rākṣasas, capable of exciting fear in others, rendered forlorn and with their friends slain, shall from fear, with their faces wet with tears, fly (this place).

sa: तान् सम्प्रभग्नान् सम्प्रेक्ष्य त्वमाणो धनंजयः। शरैराशीविषाकारैर्जधान स्वनवद्धसन्॥
en: The Trigarta warriors then began to fly. Seeing them retreat, Dhananjaya, quickly shot many shafts at them which resembled angry snakes of dreadful poison, and laughed aloud.

sa: ततः शरं सूर्यमरीचिसप्रभं सुवर्णवज्रोत्तमरत्नभूषितम्। महेन्द्रवज्राशनिपातदुःसहं मुमोच भीमाङ्गविदारणक्षमम्॥
en: Then Dushasana sent against Bhima an arrow worked with gold, diamond and other valuable gems and brilliant as the sun's rays, deadly and powerful as Indra's thunder.

sa: वर्णेभ्यो हि परिभ्रष्टो न वै सम्मानमर्हति। न तु यः सक्रियां प्राप्य राजसं कर्म सेवते॥
en: Among the six different colours that individual Soul attains at different periods of his existence, he who falls away from a superior colour deserves blame and censure. Hence, one who has acquired the result of good decds should act in such a way as to avoid all acts sullied by the quality of Darkness.

sa: पञ्चविंशतिकस्यास्य योऽयं देहेषु वर्तते। एष मोक्षयित्वयेति प्राहुरव्यक्तगोचरात्॥
en: The twenty-fifth, which lives in the bodies of living creatures, should be liberated making him know the Unmanifest or the Supreme Soul which is above the understading.
