sa: अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि प्रामाण्यमुभयोस्तयोः। शृणुष्वैकमनाः पार्थ च्छिन्नधर्मार्थसंशयम्॥
en: I shall now describe to you on the authoritativeness of both these duties, for removing your doubts about their true meaning. Listen to me with rapt attention.

sa: सर्वतः शङ्कते स्तेनो मृगो ग्राममिवेयिवान्। बहुधाऽऽचरितं पापमन्यत्रैवानुपश्यति॥
en: A thief fears every body, like a deer driven from the forest into the midst of an inhabited village. He considers other people as sinful as himself.

sa: यथान्धबधिरोन्मत्ता उच्छ्वासपरमाः सदा। देवैरपिहितद्वारा: सोपमा पश्यतो मम॥
en: As the blind, the deaf, and they who are bereft of reason, find consolation for the loss of their senses, likewise, I find consolation by their example.

sa: ततस्तेषां निषण्णानां धनदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। भवच्छन्दं समाज्ञाय नृत्येरन्नप्सरोगणाः॥
en: After all of them had taken their seats, the Lord of Riches said Understanding what your pleasure is, the various tribes of Apsaras will begin their dance.

sa: अवज्ञानमहंकारो दम्भश्चैव विगर्हितः। अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधः सर्वाश्रमगतं तपः॥
en: Insult, pride, and, deceit, also should be avoided. Abstention from injury, truth, and absence of anger, yield the merit of penances in all the modes of life.

sa: ततः पुरवरात् तस्मात् पुकषा: श्येनचेष्टनाः। गौतमेत्यभिभाषन्तः पुरद्वारमुपागमन्॥
en: At the behest of the king, certain persons, quick as hawks, went out from the splendid palace of their ruler, and proceeding to the gate accosted Gautama.

sa: सोऽहं क्रियावतां पन्थाः पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभः। यो यथा निर्मितो जन्तुर्यस्मिन् यस्मिश्च कर्मणि॥ प्रवृत्तौ वा निवृत्तौ वा तत्फलं सोऽश्नुते महत्। एष लोकगुरुर्ब्रह्मा जगदादिकरः प्रभुः॥
en: That Soul is myself. The path of those who follow acts is fraught with return. One cannot, by that path, reach the place whence there is no return. Different creatures have been created with different objects. Some are intended for the Path of Action and some for that of Renunciation. One enjoys the the reward, according to the path that he follows. This Brahman is the lord of all the worlds. Endued with power, it is he who creates the universe.

sa: सत्त्वसंसेवनान्निद्रामप्रमादाद् भयं तथा। छिन्दन्ति पञ्चमं श्वासमल्पाहारतया नृप॥
en: By cultivation of the quality of Goodness (Sattva) sleep is conquered and Fear in conquered by cultivating carefulness. Breath is conquered by restriction of diet, О king.

sa: उत्थापयामास तदा प्रभुरेकः प्रजापतिः। उवाच चैनं भगवांश्चिरस्यागतमात्मजम्॥
en: Having thus raised Mahadeva up, Brahman, that powerful and one Lord of all creatures, then addressed his son, whom he met after long time in those words.

sa: दीर्घकालेन तपसा सेवितेन तपोवने। धर्मनिर्धूतपापानां सम्पद्यन्ते मनोरथाः॥
en: By living in the woods and by practising austerities for a long period, one can wash themselves of their sins, and get the objects of their hearts.

sa: यं दृष्टवन्तस्ते साक्षाच्छ्वत्साकविभूषणम्॥ तेभ्यो धन्यतरचैव नारदः परमेष्ठिजः।
en: They, however, succeeded in seeing Narayana adorned with the beautiful mystic mark. More fortunate than my ancestors was the celestial Rishi Narada the the son of Prameshthi.

sa: अयं ब्रह्मादिभिः सिद्धैर्गुहायां गोपितः प्रभुः। देवासुरमनुष्याणामप्रकाशो भवेदिति॥
en: Beings crowned with success and having Brahman amongst them have concealed you in a cave for preventing the deities and Asuras and human beings from seeing you.

sa: यस्तांस्त्यजति शब्दादीन् सर्वाश्च व्यक्तस्तथा। विमुञ्चत् प्राकृतान्ग्रामांस्तान् मुक्त्वामृतमश्नुते॥
en: He who renounces those objects as well as all those that are manifest, he who liberates himself from all things that arise from primordial matter, enjoys immortality.

sa: ब्रह्ममृत्युरशुद्धात्मा पापमेवानुचिन्तयन्। प्रबुद्ध्यसे प्रस्वपिषि वर्तसे परमे सुखे॥
en: Dead within, you are of impure soul for you always wish to commit sin. Though you sleep, and wake, your life, however, is spent in great misery.

sa: स्वप्ने हि रजसा देही तमसा चाभिभूयते। देहान्तरमिवापन्नश्चरत्युपगतस्पृहः॥
en: In dreams, the embodied soul, possessed by the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance, seems to become possessed of another body and move and act influenced by desire.

sa: श्रद्दधानः शुभां विद्यां हीनादपि समाप्नुयात्। सुवर्णमपि चामेध्यादाददीताविचारयन्।॥
en: One may gain useful knowledge from even a person of degraded calling, with devotion and reverence. One may take up gold, unhesitatingly from even an unclean spot.

sa: एवं विस्तारसंक्षेपौ ब्रह्माव्यक्ते पुनः पुनः। युगसाहस्रयोरादावहोरात्रस्तथैव च॥
en: Even thus does Unmanifest Brahma repeatedly practise the processes of Creation and Destruction, and even thus are Brahman's Day and Night each consisting of a thousand Yugas.

sa: स्वर्गलोको गृहस्थानामुदारमनसां हितः। स्वर्गो विमानसंयुक्तो वेददृष्टः सुपुष्पितः॥
en: Heaven has been ordained for all great householders. That heaven is filled with charming cars for each. Even that is the charming heaven described in the Vedas.

sa: शुश्रूषाभिस्तपोभिश्च विद्यामादाय भारत। ये प्रतिग्रहनि:स्नेहास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who having acquired knowledge by making obedient services to their preceptors and performing austere penances, are unwilling to accept gifts, succeed in ascending to heaven.

sa: स्पर्शरूपरसाद्येषु सङ्गं गच्छन्ति बालिशाः। नावगच्छन्त्यविज्ञानादात्मानं पार्थिवं गुणम्॥
en: Only the fools become attached to the objects of the senses. On account of folly they do not know that their bodies are only modifications of earth.

sa: सम्मोहकं तमो विद्यात् कृष्णमज्ञानसम्भवम्। प्रीतिदुःखनिबद्धांश्च समस्तांस्त्रीनथो गुणान्॥
en: Ignorance produces delusions. It is like Darkness and is born of Ignorance. All the joys and sorrows belong to the three qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance.

sa: संदेहः सुमहानेष विरुद्ध इति मे मतिः। इह यः सहधर्मो वै प्रेत्यायं विहितः क्व नु॥
en: Grcat is the doubt that fills my mind about. Indeed, I think that the declaration to which I refer is contrary to the natural impulses which lead to a union of the sexes. The union in this world for performing duties together ceases with death and is not to be seen to exit hereafter.

sa: विचारश्च विवेकश्च वितर्कश्चपजायते। मुनेः समादधानस्य प्रथमं ध्यानमादितः॥
en: When one observing the vow of silence, begins to set his mind of Yoga, then discrimination, knowledge, and power to avoid cvil follow him in the trail.

sa: विषयैरर्थवान् धर्ममाराधयितुमुत्तमम्। कामं च चरितुं शक्तो दुष्प्रापमकृतात्मभिः॥
en: Even persons of impure souls, if possessed of various sorts of wealth, can perform the highest acts of virtue and gratify desires that cannot be easily satisfied.

sa: आस्तिक्यव्यवसायाभ्यामुपायाद् विस्मयाद् धिया। समारभेदनिन्द्यात्मा न सोऽर्थः परिषीदति॥
en: That act which a man of pure soul does with faith and earnestness, with the help of proper means, without pride, and with intelligence, becomes never lost.

sa: ततो मन्दाकिनी रम्यामुपरिष्टादभिव्रजन्॥ शुको ददर्श धर्मात्मा पुष्पितदुमकाननाम्।
en: The pious Shuka then saw from a high region the extremely beautiful celestial river Mandakini, running below through a region adorned by many flowering groves and forests.

sa: नारायणीयमाख्यानमेतत् ते कथितं मया। पृष्टेन शौनकाद्येह नैमिषारण्यवासिषु॥
en: Accosted by you, O Shaunaka, I have duly recounted to you and all these Rishis who inhabit the Naimisha forest, that great discourse having Narayana for theme.

sa: यथादृष्टं यथातत्त्वं यथोक्तमुभयोर्निशि। तत् सर्वमानुपूर्वेण शशंसास्मै वृषस्तदा॥
en: And Vrisha (Karna) faithfully related to him everything in detail, viz. his meeting with the sun and the conversation that took place between them during the nighi.

sa: मुचुकुन्दस्ततो राजा सोऽन्वशासद् वसुन्धराम्। बाहुवीर्यार्जितां सम्यक् क्षत्रधर्ममनुव्रतः॥
en: Then after that did the king Muchukunda rule over this earth which he earned by the prowess of his arms following closely the duties of a Kshatriya.

sa: मायोपधः प्रणिपातार्जवाभ्यां तपोदमाभ्यां धर्मगुप्त्या बलेना स्तितिक्षमाणः क्लिश्यमानोऽतिवेलम्॥
en: Graced with meekness and benevolence, with asceticism and self-control and with might attended with virtue, speaking the truth, (Yudhishthira), a prey to deception, has borne great sufferings.

sa: अभिवाद्य नमस्कृत्य मातामहमथाब्रुवन्। उच्चैरनुपमैः स्निग्धैः स्वरैरापूर्य मेदिनीम्॥
en: Bowed down and said the same thing to their maternal grand father, filling the earth with loud and sweet ponds the like of which there was none.

sa: तपन्तमभि को मन्दः पतिष्यति पतङ्गवत्। पाण्डवाग्निमनावार्यं मुमूर्षुर्नष्टचेतनः॥
en: What fool, about to die and who has lost his consciousness is there who will fall into the inextinguishable fire of the Pandavas ablaze like a moth.

sa: असंग्राहाः सुसम्पन्ना हेमभाण्डपरिच्छदाः। अनेकशतसाहस्राः सर्वे सादिवशे स्थिताः॥
en: All the horses numbering many hundreds and thousands were kept under proper control and were free from the habit of scratching the ground with the fore feet.

sa: कथं च ज्ञातयस्तात श्रेयांसः साधुसम्मताः अथान्याय्यमुपस्थातुं जिह्येनाजिह्मचारिणः॥
en: How could your cousins, my dear fellow, who are worthy in every respect and of honest turns of mind and virtuous, unite themselves with this deceitful one?

sa: अत्रानलसखस्यापि पवनस्य निवेशनम्। महर्षेः कश्यपस्यात्र मारीचस्य निवेशनम्॥
en: Here is also the residence of Pavana (wind) the friend of Anala (fire) and here is the residence of the great Rishi Kashyapa, the son of Maricha.

sa: योऽतर्पयदमेयात्मा खाण्डवे जातवेदसम्। सोऽन्तःपुरगतः पार्थ कूपेऽग्निरिव संवृतः॥
en: That Pritha's son, who with his immeasurable energy gratified the fire-god in the Khandava forest, is now stationed in the seraglio like fire concealed in a well.

sa: भक्ष्यांश्च विविधाकारान् बहूंचोच्चावचांस्तदा। कारयामास कुशलैरन्नं पानं सुशोभनम्॥
en: Then he had various kinds of food, diverse sorts of meat of excellent degree and delicious drinks, and dishes prepared by the cooks skilled in the business.

sa: सम्यग्वृत्तेष्वलुब्धेषु सततं धर्मचारिषु। स्वेषु बन्धुषु कः साधुश्चरेदेवमसाम्प्रतम्॥
en: What good man would treat in this unbecoming way his own near kinsmen of good habits of life, who are not covetous and who always practice virtues.

sa: इत्युक्तो देवराजस्तु पार्थभीष्मसमागमम्। पूजयामास दिव्येन पुष्पवर्षेण भारत॥
en: O Bharata! Indra, the king of gods revealed honour for this excellent battle between Arjuna and Bhishma with showing flowers on them when so reported by Chitrasena.

sa: स समासाद्य पौलस्त्यममात्यैरभिसंवृतम्। रामसंदेशमामन्त्र्य वाग्मी वक्तुं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: And that eloquent (monkey) having approached and saluted the descendant of Pulastya who was surrounded by (his) ministers, began to deliver Rama's message (in the following words).

sa: निग्रहीतुं किलेच्छन्ति सहिता वासवानुजम्। इमं पुरुषशार्दूलमप्रधृष्यं दुरासदम्॥
en: They desire to capture along with the younger brother of Vasava-this best among men, who is incapable of being vanquished, and in fact hard to stand against.

sa: ततो देशेषु देशेषु रमणीयेषु भागशः। सर्वरत्नसमाकीर्णा: सभाश्चक्रुरनेकशः॥
en: Then in all places and in the most enchanting sites there were erected many pavilions (at proper intervals) adorned with all sorts of gems and precious stones.

sa: ततः समुद्यम्य भुजौ पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ। नखदंष्ट्राभिरन्योन्यं घतः क्रोधविषोद्धतौ॥
en: They raised up their arms like two snakes having five hoods; and worked up with the poison of anger, they attacked each other with nails and teeth.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नमहं मन्ये सहेद् भीष्मस्य सायकान्। वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शान् दीप्तास्यानुरगानिव॥
en: I think that this Dhrishtadyumra will be able to withstand the arrows of Bhishma, which strike with the force the thunderbolt and which look like blazing serpents,

sa: पाण्डवाः समबोध्यन्त बाल्यात् प्रभृति केशव। ये स्म वारणशब्देन हयानां हेषितेन च॥ रथनेमिनिनादैश्च व्यबोध्यन्त तदा गृहे। शङ्खभेरीनिनादेन वेणुवीणानुनादिना॥ पुण्याहघोषमिश्रेण पूज्यमाना द्विजातिभिः। वस्त्रै रत्नैरलंकारैः पूजयन्तो द्विजन्मनः॥ गीर्भिर्मङ्गलयुक्ताभिर्ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम्। अर्चितैरर्चनाहश्च स्तुवद्भिरभिनन्दिताः॥ प्रासादाचेष्वबोध्यन्त राङ्कवाजिनशायिनः। क्रूरं च निनदं श्रुत्वा श्वापदानां महावने॥
en: Were the Pandavas awakened from their sleep ever since their infancy, O Keshava; who again, were by the roar of elephants and neighing of horses and by the rattles of the wheels of the chariots awakened from sleep at home-also by the sound of conches and cymbals accompanied with the music of flutes and lyres; and whose praises were sung by the twice-born at the break of day in high sounding songs; and who worshipped the deserving Brahmanas with the raiment's, gems and jewels; who, worthy of respect, themselves were blessed and done homage to by the largesouled Brahmanas by laudatory hymns and worshipped as well. How could they, lying on soft blankets and skin of the Ranku deer in the best parts of the palace, be awakened by hearing the loud roar of animals in the great forest?

sa: प्रादुर्भूतेषु चैतेषु भयमाहुरुपस्थितम्। निमित्तेषु महाबाहो दारुणं प्राणिनाशनम्॥
en: When such omens prevail, it is said, that a great calamity is at hand causing, O you of long arms, a very great massacre of living beings.

sa: ततोऽभिसृत्य तैर्विप्रैः सर्वैराश्रमवासिभिः। परिवार्य समाश्वास्य तावानीतौ स्वमाश्रमम्॥
en: Then all the twice-born ones, dwelling in the (neighbouring) hermitages approached and surrounded them. And soothing the old couple they brought them back to their own hermitage.

sa: अपारमप्लवागाधं समुद्रं शरवेधिनम्। भीमसेनमयं दुर्गं तात मन्दास्तितीर्षवः॥
en: That inaccessible ocean, which has no shore, which is unfathomable and which has currents in the shape of Bhima, those wicked ones are desirous of crossing over.

sa: पाञ्चजन्यस्य निर्घोषं विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः। निशम्य सर्वसैन्यानि समहृष्यन्त सर्वशः॥
en: All the soldiers of the army became cheerful in every way at hearing the sound of the Panchajanya conch which was similar to the roaring of thunder.

sa: संक्षोभश्चापि सत्त्वानामनावृष्टिकृतोऽभवत्। देवाश्चापि भृशं त्रस्तास्तथा सर्वे महर्षयः॥
en: And there came distress among the beings of the earth, owing to death of rain and the gods and the great Rishis remained struck with intense fear.

sa: ततो भागानुभागेन देवगन्धर्वपन्नगाः। अवतर्तुं महीं सर्वे मन्त्रयामासुरञ्जसा॥
en: At this, the celestial, the Gandharvas and the Danavas quickly assembled to consult as to how they should he born on earth according to their respective parts.

sa: ततस्ते क्षत्रियानेव पप्रच्छुर्द्विजसत्तमाः। तेभ्यः शशंसुर्धर्मज्ञा याथातथ्यं पितामह॥
en: Then did these best among the twice-born asked the Kshatriya the cause of his and O grandfather, and those men conversant with virtue told them the truth.

sa: अकामद्वेषसंयोगलोभाद्रोहाच भारत। उपेक्षया च भावानां देवा देवत्वमाप्नुवन्॥
en: From an absence of desire and of hatred and of avarice and of anxiety and for their indifference to worldly property, did the gods obtain their god-ships.

sa: रामस्तु पुनराशङ्कय पौरजानपदागमम्। प्रविवेश महारण्यं शरभङ्गाश्रमं प्रति॥
en: And Rama too, afraid of the return of the people of the cities and provinces entered into the mighty forest of Dandaka near the hermitage of Sharabhanga.

sa: एतावच्छक्यमस्माभिर्वक्तुं द्रष्टासि जानकीम्। ध्रुवं वानरराजस्य विदितो रावणालयः॥
en: Thus far I am able to say that you the daughter of Janaka again. It is certain that the abode of Ravana is known to the monkeyking.

sa: सर्वे येन भीमबला यक्षा राक्षसाश्च पुरा हताः॥
en: My sons were not all killed by that one of independent mind by whom Yakshas of terrible strength and the Rakshasas were killed in days of old.

sa: अनृजुस्त्वनुरक्तोऽपि सम्पन्नश्चेतरैर्गुणैः। राज्ञः प्रज्ञानयुक्तोऽपि न मन्त्रं श्रोतुमर्हति॥
en: An wily person, even if he be devoted to his master and possessed of wisdom and adorned with numerous accomplishments, should never be consulted by the king.

sa: तस्याद्य न प्रपश्यामि प्रतियोद्धारमाहवे। त्वामृते पुरुषव्याघ्र शार्दूलसमविक्रमम्॥
en: I do not find a match for him in battle except you, O best of men, who are possessed of prowess equal to that of a tiger.

sa: तयोर्युद्धं महचासीत् संग्रामे भरतर्षभ।॥ प्रभिन्नयोर्यथा सक्तं मत्तयोर्वरहस्तिनोः।
en: The encounter between those two heroes was exceedingly dreadful, O best of Bharata's race, like that between two wild and infuriate elephants with temporal juice trickling down.

sa: द्रौपदेयांस्तथा वीरानैकैकं दशभिः शरैः॥ अविद्ध्यदाचार्यसुतो नातिक्रुद्धो हसन्निव।
en: The preceptor's son Ashvatthama, not excited with anger and as if smiling in that battle, struck each of the five heroic sons of Draupadi with ten arrows.

sa: अन्योन्यकृतवैराणां पुत्रपौत्रं नियच्छति। पुत्रपौत्रविनाशे च परलोकं नियच्छति॥
en: The very sons and grandsons of persons, who have injured each other, meet with destruction. For such destruction of their children, they lose the next world also.

sa: तन्नारदवचः श्रुत्वा साब्रवीदृषिसंसदि॥ तपसोऽर्धं प्रयच्छामि पाणिग्राहस्य सत्तम।
en: Hearing these words of Narada, the old lady went to an assemblage of Rishis and said, 'I shall give him half my penances who will marry ine.'

sa: असम्भवश्च धर्माणामीदृशानामराजसु॥ तस्माद् राजैव नान्योऽस्ति यो धर्मफलमाप्नुयात्।
en: Persons who are not kings do not gain merit like this. A person, therefore, who is a king, and no other can earn such rewards of virtue.

sa: स शून्यमाश्रमं रम्यमापवस्य महात्मनः। ददाह पवनेनेद्धश्चित्रभानुः सहैहयः॥
en: Helped by the king of the Haihayas the god of fire, increased more by the wind, consumed the uninhabited but the charming hermitage of the high-souled Apava.

sa: क्ष्वेडा: किलकिलाशब्दाः क्रकचा गोविषाणिकाः। भेरीमृदङ्गपणवान नादयेयुः पुरश्चरान्॥
en: Those who have gone in advance should utter loud shouts and make various kinds of noises and should blow and beas Krakachas, cow-horns, drums, cymbals, and kettle-drums.'

sa: एवं विचरतस्तस्य संग्रामे राजसत्तम॥ सम्प्रेषयच्छितान् पार्थः शरानाशीविषोपमान्।
en: While Shalya was thus fighting in that battle, that best of kings, the son of Pritha, shot at him many arrows that resembled snakes of virulent poison.

sa: स ददर्श महावीर्यं देवदेवमुमापतिम्। शैलपुत्र्या समासीनं भूतसंघशतैर्वृतम्॥
en: One day, the highly energetic child, saw that god of gods, viz., the lord of Uma, seated with the daughter of Himavat, amid a number of goblins.

sa: रुक्मपुङस्तैलधौतैः कर्मारपरिमार्जितैः॥ ते दह्यमानाः पार्थेन पावकेनेव कुञ्जराः।
en: The entire earth was as if covered with gold-winged arrows, steeped in oil, polished by the hands of the smith and with Partha's name engraven on it.

sa: प्रवर्तनाद् द्वापरस्य यथाभागमुपाश्नुते। कलेः प्रवर्तनाद् राजा पापमत्यन्तमश्नुते॥
en: If he creates the Dvapara, he attains to blessedness in heaven in proportion to his merits. By creating the Kali age, the king incurs a heavy sin.

sa: स शीघ्रगामिना तेन रथेन यदुपुङ्गवः। दिदृक्षुरभिसम्प्राप्तः शिष्ययुद्धमुपस्थितम्॥
en: Journeying then on that highly fleet car Baladeva, that best of Yadu's race, desirous of seeing the approaching encounter of his two disciples, arrived on the field.”

sa: आत्मानमात्मनाऽऽश्वास्य मा शुचः पुरुषर्षभ। नाद्य शोकाभिभूतस्त्वं कायमुत्स्रष्टुमर्हसि॥
en: Solacing yourself, by you own self, cease to grieve, O best of men. You should not allow yourself to be overwhelmed with sorrow and to all action.

sa: भृशमुद्विग्नमनसस्ते पौराः कुरुसंक्षये। प्राक्रोशन्त महाराज स्वनुरक्तास्तदा भृशम्॥
en: The citizens also of Hastinapura devoted to the Kurus, whit hearts filled with anxiety at the destruction of their rulers, O king, cried aloud like those ladies.

sa: ततो विमर्दः सुमहान् बभूव तत्रार्जुनस्याधिरथेश्च राजन्। विषाणघातैर्द्विपयोरिवोग्रैः॥
en: O king, then the fight between Arjuna and the son of Adhiratha assumed attacking each other with their tusks, they went on hitting each other with shafts.

sa: वृतं समन्ताद् बहुभिः श्वापदै?रदर्शनैः। निवारयन्तं कृच्छ्रात्ताश्वापदांश्च चिखादिषून्।
en: He was then encircled by a large number of carnivorous animals of dreadful forms, and by wolves and hyenas, that stood near for fceding upon his body.

sa: पितृमेधाश्च केषांचित् प्रावर्तन्त महात्मनाम्। सामभिश्चाप्यगायन्त तेऽन्वशोचन्त चापरैः॥
en: The Pitri-medha rites in honor of some of the great persons who were dead were performed there, while some sang Samans, and some cried for the dead.

sa: तदुद्यतगदाप्रासमाकपुरुषसेवितम्। प्रावर्तत महद् युद्धं राजन् दुर्मन्त्रिते तव॥
en: On account of your evil counsels, O king, a dreadful battle took place in which maces and lances were used and in which heroes only took part.

sa: उपशिक्षाम ते वृत्तं सदैव न च शक्नुमः॥
en: 'You are, O king, conversant with all duties. There is nothing unknown to you. We always wish to imitate your conduct, but, alas, we cannot do it.

sa: एवं पर्याकुले लोके वितथैर्जर्जरीकृते। तैस्तैायैर्महाराज पुराणं धर्ममाचर॥
en: In this world that is unsubstantial full of abuses and painful, O king, do you practise the old customs of men, following rules and examples quoted above.

sa: येषामुन्मत्तको ज्येष्ठः सर्वे तेऽप्यनुसारिणः। तवोन्मादान्महाराज सोन्मादाः सर्वपाण्डवाः॥
en: They whose eldest brother runs mad, have all to follow him like mad men. For your madness, O king, all the Pandavas, are about to become mad.

sa: ततोऽदीर्घेण कालेन कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। पितुरन्तर्दधे कीर्ति शीलवृत्तसमाधिभिः॥
en: Thereupon, within a very short time, the son of Kunti, Yudhisthira, overshadowed the deeds of his faiher by his good behaviour, manners and close application to business.

sa: अथ कर्मान्तरे राजा समाहूय महामुनीन्। पार्थिवाश्च नरव्याघ्रः पण्डितान्नैगमांस्तथा।।।। पौराणिकाशब्दविदो ये वृद्धाश्च द्विजातयः। स्वराणां लक्षणज्ञांश्च उत्सुकान्द्विजसत्तमान्॥ लक्षणज्ञांश्च गान्धर्वान्नैगमांश्च विशेषतः। पादाक्षरसमासज्ञांश्छन्दःसु परिनिष्ठितान्॥ कलामात्राविशेषज्ञाज्योतिषे च परं गतान्। क्रियाकल्पविदश्चैव तथा कार्यविशारदान्॥ हेतूपचारकुशलान्हैतुकांश्च बहुश्रुतान्। छन्दोविदः पुराणज्ञान्वैदिकान्द्विजसत्तमान्।।।। चित्रज्ञान्वृत्तसूत्रज्ञान्गीतनृत्यविशारदान्। एतान्सर्वान्समानीय गातारौ समवे
en: There upon taking leave from business for some time and inviting the great ascetic Vālmīki, kings, learned men, persons well-versed in Nyāya, Purāņas and science of words, all old men, twice-born ones those conversant with the signs of music, Brāhmaṇas desirous of hearing the Rāmāyaṇa, persons deep read in palmistry, Gandharvas, citizens, all those who have mastered the use of words, letters and Samāsas, those who have studied well metres, those well informed in the science of music, those wellversed in astronomy, those who are well up in the knowledge of rites and ceremonies, those expert in the despatch of business, logicians whose fame has spread far and wide, those wellversed in reasoning and arguments, poets, historians, Vedic Brahmanas, painters, and songsters Rāma requested Lava and

sa: पुराणपूर्णचन्द्रेण श्रुतिज्योत्स्नाः प्रकाशिताः। नृबुद्धिकौरवाणां च कृतमेतत् प्रकाशनम्॥
en: As the Full Moon with its mild light opens the buds of the water-lily, so does this Purana with the light of Shruti expand the human intellect.

sa: अन्तरे चैव संप्राप्ते कलिद्वापरयोरभूत्। समन्तपञ्चके युद्धं कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः॥
en: At the end of Dwapara and in the beginning of Kali, a great battle was fought between the Kurus and the Pandavas, here at this holy Samantapanchaka.

sa: यात्रामारभसे दिष्ट्या प्राप्तकालमरिंदम। पार्णिमूलं च विज्ञाय व्यवसायं पराजयम्। बलस्य च महाराज दत्त्वा वेतनमग्रतः॥ कच्चिच्च बलमुख्येभ्यः परराष्ट्र परंतप। उपच्छन्नानि रत्नानि प्रयच्छसि यथार्हतः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, when the (proper) time comes, taking into your consideration all the omens you might see and having been convinced that the resolutions you have formed and their unsuccesses depend on the twelve Mandalas and having paid your troops their pays do you begin your march? O great king, O chastiser of foes, do you have gems and jewels to the chief officers of the enemy as they (each of them) deserve without the knowledge of the enemy?

sa: ततो बद्धाङ्गुलित्राणा बद्धकक्षा महारथाः। बद्धतूणाः सधनुषो विविशुर्भरतर्षभाः॥
en: Then the best of the Bharata race, (the princes), those mighty car-warriors, having girt up their lions, entered (the arena) equipped with bows, quivers and finger protectors.

sa: पुरोचनाद्रक्षमाणाः संवत्सरमतन्द्रिताः। सुरुङ्गां कारयित्वा तु विदुरेण प्रचोदिताः॥
en: They lived in the house for one year, watchfully protecting themselves from Purochana. In the meantime they dug a subterranean passage according to the directions of Vidura.

sa: स भुक्तवान्नर श्रेष्ठो गीतामाधुर्यमुत्तमम्। शुश्राव रामचरितं तस्मिन्काले यथा कृतम्॥ तन्त्रीलयसमायुक्तं त्रिस्थानकरणान्वितम्। संस्कृतं लक्षणोपेतं समतालसमन्वितम्।।१५।
en: After meals, Satrughna, the foremost of men, listened to themes relating to Rāma and set musical notes. Those themes were composed describing the early actions of Rāma. They were composed in Sanskrit, set to the tune of a musical instrument, adorned with all the marks of vocal music and arranged in accompaniment with notes.

sa: सर्वमूर्धाभिषिक्तानामेष मूनि ज्वलिष्यति। प्रभाहरोऽयं सर्वेषां ज्योतिषामिव भास्करः॥
en: He will blaze forth above the heads of all that wear crowns on their heads. Like the sun he will rob all other kings of their splendour.

sa: स राजा शान्तनुर्धीमान् देवराजसमद्युतिः। बभूव मृगयाशील: शान्तनुर्वनगोचरः॥
en: That greatly intelligent king Shantanu, as effulgent as the king of the celestials, became a lover of hunting and passed much of his time in the woods.

sa: अथावसाने यज्ञस्य पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्। वसिष्ठरूपी राजानमिति होवाच राक्षसः॥
en: Thereupon when the sacrifice was about to be finished the aforesaid Rākşasa, remembering his former enmity, assumed the shape of Vasiştha and said to the king Saudāsa.

sa: आसीद्विभावसुर्नाम महर्षिः कोपनो भृशम्। भ्राता तस्यानुजश्चासीत्सुप्रतीको महातपाः॥
en: There was in the olden days a great Rishi, named Vibhavasu, who was of exceedingly angry disposition. He had a younger brother, named Supratika, a great ascetic.

sa: तं शयानं नरव्याघ्रं निद्रा नाभ्यागमत्तदा। चिन्तयानमनेकार्थं रामगीतमनुत्तमम्॥
en: There upon going to bed, ſatrughna began to meditate upon that excellent theme relating to Rāma and treating of diverse subjects and did not enter into sleep.

sa: दिव्यतेजोवृतं व्योम ज्योतिर्भूतमनुत्तमम्। स्वयंप्रभैः स्वतेजोभिः स्वर्गिभिः पुण्यकर्मभिः॥
en: The aerial way was full of lustre but its brilliance was increased the more by the native effulgence of the inhabitants of heavens, always performing pious actions.

sa: अथ द्रोणाभ्यनुज्ञाताः कदाचित् कुरुपाण्डवाः। ग्थैर्विनिर्ययुः सर्वे मृगयामरिमर्दन॥
en: O chastiser of foes, one day the Kuru and the Pandu princes with the permission of Drona all set out on their cars to a hunting excursion.

sa: यः पुमानभवत्तत्र तं स राजर्षिसत्तमः। वसुर्वसुप्रदश्चक्रे सेनापतिमरिंदमः॥
en: The best of royal sages and the giver of wealth and the punisher of enemies, (Vasu) made the son of the river the generalissimo of his army.

sa: प्रांशुः कनकतालाभः सिंहसंहननो युवा। असंख्येयगुणः श्रीमान् भास्करस्यात्मसम्भवः॥
en: Being born of the sun, he was tall like a golden palm; he was a youth who could slay lions. He was handsome and possessed countless accomplishments.

sa: सौतिरुवाच पतिष्यमाणे नागेन्द्रे तक्षके जातवेदसि। इदमन्तरमित्येवं तदास्तीकोऽभ्यचोदयत्॥
en: Sauti said : When the king of snakes, Takshaka, was at the point of falling into the sacrificial fire, within that very short moment, Astika spoke thus,

sa: कथं तव कुलस्यैकामिमां बालामनागसम्। पितृपैतामहे मार्गे नियोक्तुमहमुत्सहे॥
en: How shall I be able to place this only daughter of your house, this innocent girl, in the (virtuous) way in which her ancestors have always walked?

sa: तैर्वृतः पुरुषव्याघ्रो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। विबभौ देवसंकाशो वज्रपाणिरिवामरैः॥
en: Being thus surrounded by them, that best of men, the king of virtue, Yudhisthira, looked as effulgent as the thunderer (Indra) in the midst of the celestial.

sa: जराशोकक्लमापेता निरातङ्का शिवा शुभा। वेश्मासनवती रम्या दिव्यपादपशोभिता॥
en: It dispels decrepitude, grief, fatigue, and fear; it is beneficial and auspicious, it is furnished with rooms and seats, it is charming and adorned with celestials trees.

sa: प्रायात् प्रतीची हरितं विचिन्वंश्च ततस्ततः। उत्तरामगमच्छीमान्दिशं हिमवतावृताम्॥
en: And searching that Śūdra devotee here and there Rāghava proceeded towards the west. And not beholding him there he went to the North bounded by the Himālayas.

sa: सर्वे संग्रामविद्यासु विद्याभिजनशोभिनः। सर्वेषामनुरूपाश्च कृता दारा महीपते॥
en: O king, all of them were mighty in attack and defence and all of them were learned. They married wives suitable to them in beauty and accomplishments.

sa: त्वमेकः सर्वमत्र्येषु विमानवरमास्थितः। चरिष्यस्युपरिस्थो हि देवो विग्रहवानिव॥
en: You only, among all mortals on earth, will ride on that best of cars and go through the sky like a celestial, though possessing a physical body.

sa: रुरुरुवाच किमर्थं भगवान्सूर्यो लोकान्दग्धुमनास्तदा। किमस्यापहृतं देवैयेनमं मन्युराविशत्॥
en: Ruru said: What for did the highly noble sun resolve to burn the world? What wrongs were done to him by the celestials, that he grew angry?

sa: धारणाद्धर्ममित्याहुर्धर्मेण विधृताः प्रजाः। यस्माद्धारयते सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्॥
en: He is called Dharma because he hold all. It is Dharma (virtue) that uphold all mankind. It is by Dharma that the three worlds are being preserved.

sa: ततः पितामहः साक्षादभिगम्य महासुरौ। वरेणच्छन्दयामास सर्वलोकहितः प्रभुः॥
en: Thereupon the Grandsire (Brahma) himself came to those two heroes and the Lord who seeks the welfare of all, asked them to solicit the boon they desired,

sa: यथा च युद्धमभवत्पृथिवीक्षयकारकम्। तत्तेऽहं कथयिष्यामि पृच्छते भरतर्षभ।॥
en: And how the battle was fought to exterminate all men. O best of the Bharata race, I shall relate all this to you as you ask me.

sa: श्रुत्वा ह्यमरसंकाश तव वाक्यमरिंदम। ध्रुवं विवाहकरणमास्थास्यामि विधानतः॥
en: O celestials like hero, O chastiser of foes, hearing your reply, I shall then make arrangements for the marriage according to the order to which you belong.

sa: दीर्घबाहुं महोरस्कं वृषभाक्षमरिंदमम्। सुभद्रा सुषुवे वीरमभिमन्युं नरर्षभम्॥
en: He was of long arms, broad chest and bulllike eyes; that chastiser of focs, that best of men, that hero, the son of Subhadra, was named Abhimanyu.

sa: स सात्वत्यामतिरथः सम्बभूव धनंजयात्। मखे निर्मथनेनेव शमीगर्भाद्भुतासनः॥
en: That great hero was begotten by Dhananjaya on the maiden of the Satvata race, like fire produced by rubbing in a sacrifice from within the Sami wood.

sa: एवंगुणसमायुक्तं ददर्श स वनं नृपः। नदीकच्छोद्भवं कान्तमुच्छ्रितध्वजसंनिभम्॥
en: The king saw that forest endued with such beauties. It was situated in the delta of a river and looked like a pole erected in Indra's honour.

sa: विनिद्रकरणं घोरं हृदि शल्यमिवार्पितम्। शोकपावकमुद्भूतं कर्मणैतेन नाशय॥
en: Extinguish by this act the grief that consumes me like a fire, that robs me of my sleep and that princes my heart like a terrible dart.

sa: अदृष्टपूर्वा भगवन्कस्याप्येषा महात्मनः। पत्नी श्रीरिव संमोहाद्विरौति विकृतानना॥
en: O great Rşi, we do not know the wife of what great man, beautiful like the very Lakşmī, and not seen before, is crying aloud very poorly?

sa: अचिर्धाराभिसम्बद्धं धूमविद्युत्समाकुलम्। बभूव तद् वनं घोरं स्तनयित्नुसमाकुलम्॥
en: Then the flames fought with that heavy shower and those masses of clouds overhead. The forest, being filled with smoke and lightings, became fearful to look at.

sa: यदि शब्दापयेद्रामः श्रवणाय महीपतिः। ऋषीणामुपविष्टानां यथायोगं प्रवर्तताम्॥
en: If Rāma, the lord of earth, invites you to sing the Rāmāyaṇa, you may fearlessly sing it there in due notes and measures before the assembled ascetics.

sa: संस्कारैः संस्कृतास्ते तु व्रताध्ययनसंयुताः। श्रमव्यायामकुशलाः समपद्यन्त यौवनम्॥
en: They passed through the usual rites of their order; they engaged themselves in study and vows; they grew up into youths, expert in athletic sports and labour.

sa: कम्पयन्तश्च सर्वेषामुरगाणां मनांसि च। सर्पानाजुहुवुस्तत्र सर्वानग्निमुखे तदा॥
en: Making the hearts of all the snakes tremble in fear, they began to pour ghee in the mouth of the Agni, uttering the names of the snakes.

sa: यक्ष्यन्ति च नरव्याघ्रा निर्जित्य पृथिवीमिमाम्। राजसूयाश्वमेधाद्यैः क्रतुभिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः॥
en: Conquering the whole world, these best of men will perform Rajasuya and Ashvamedha and other sacrifices in which Dakshina (presents to the Brahmanas) will be very large.

sa: अपेतशस्त्रसन्नाहान् सन्नद्धान् पाण्डुसृजयान्। प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय द्रौणिः प्रहरतां वरः॥
en: That best of strikers, viz., the son of Drona, sent to the abode of Yama all those Pandus and Srinjayas who were deprived of armour and weapons.

sa: नातिदूरापयाते तु रथे रथवरप्रणुत्। धनुर्गृहीत्वा यन्तारं लब्धसंज्ञोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: The chariot had not been taken far off, when that foremost of warriors (Pradyumna) regained his consciousness. Taking up his bow, he thus spoke to his charioteer.

sa: अक्रुद्ध्यन्तोऽनसूयन्तो निरहकारमत्सराः। ऋजवः शमसम्पन्नाः शिष्टाचारा भवन्ति ते॥
en: Those men are reckoned to be virtuous, who never show wrath, pride or haughtiness and malice or whose conduct is ever marked by simplicity and quiet due.

sa: तेन तज्जलमादत्तं जरयत्यग्निमारुतौ। आहारपरिणामाच्च स्नेहो वृद्धिश्च जायते॥
en: Fire and wind cause the water thus drawn up to be digested. The tree grows and becomes humid proportionate to the quantity of the water taken up.

sa: पितामहमुपागम्य प्रणिपत्यकृताञ्जलिः। सर्वानेवासुरान् जित्वा बलिं पप्रच्छ वासवः॥
en: After having defeated all the Assuras, one day Vasava went to the Grandfather and joining his hands bowed to him and enquired after the whereabouts of Vali.

sa: आश्रित्य धर्मराजानं सर्वलोकोऽवसत् सुखम्। पुण्यलक्षणकर्माणं स्वदेहमिव देहिनः॥
en: As a soul lives happily depending on the body blessed with auspicious marks and pious deeds, so all the subjects lived most happily, depending on Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira).

sa: घोररूपं महाराज भीरूणां भयवर्धनम्। अम्बष्ठान् मालवान् वङ्गाञ्छिबींस्त्रगर्तकानपि॥
en: Terrible to look at, highly dreadful and increasing the terror of the cowards. Large numbers of the Ambhastas, the Malavas the Vangas, the Sivis and the Trigartas.

sa: कृतातिथ्यं तु गोविन्दं विदुरः सर्वधर्मवित्। कुशलं पाण्डुपुत्राणामपृच्छन्मधुसूदनम्॥
en: Vidura, conversant with all the virtues, having finished the rites of hospitality to Govinda, asked the slayer of Madhu about the welfare of the sons of Pandu.

sa: वेदस्योपनिषत् सत्यं सत्यस्योपनिषद् दमः। दमस्योपनिषन्मोक्ष एतत् सर्वानुशासनम्॥
en: Truth is the essence of the Vedas. The essence of Truth is self-control. The essence of self-control is Liberation. This is the teaching of all the scriptures.

sa: पृष्टाभरणसम्पन्नो भूषणैरर्कसंनिभैः। षितः सर्वगात्रेषु देवगर्भः श्रिया ज्वलन्॥
en: Decorated with the many ornaments that he wore and that were as brilliant as the sun himself, that child of a celestial girl shone in great beauty.

sa: स पाण्डवयुगान्तार्कः कुरूनप्यभ्यतीतपत्। प्रददाह कुरून् सर्वानर्जुनः शस्त्रतेजसा॥
en: Like the comet risen at the end of a Yuga burning every creature. Arjuna then began to blast with the power of his weapons the Kuru hosts.

sa: सर्वमूर्धाभिषिक्तानामाचार्यो ब्रह्मवित्तमः। अर्जुनस्य सुतं मूढं नायं हन्तुमिहेच्छति॥
en: “The preceptor of all venerable Kshatriyas, this one foremost of all those conversant with Brahma, does not, out of affection, wish to slay the son of Arjuna.

sa: दुःशासनौघं शलशल्यमत्स्यं सुषेणचित्रायुधनागनक्रम्। जयद्रथाद्रिं पुरुमित्रगाधं दुर्मर्षणोदं शकुनिप्रपातम्॥
en: Yuyutsu and Bhagadatta as its gale, Shrutayus and the son of Hridika its gulfs and bay, Dushasana its waves, Sushena and Chitrayudha its sea elephants and crocodiles,

sa: सुयुद्धं चार्जुनस्यासीदहं तु द्रोणमन्वियाम्। यौधिष्ठिराभ्यनीकानि प्रहरन्ति ततस्ततः॥
en: And Arjuna on the other. I, however, followed Drona's division. Then the diverse divisions of Yudhishthira's army began to strike down the eneiny's host on the field.

sa: जायन्ते विवृतास्याश्च व्याहरन्तोऽशिवा गिरः। त्रिपदाः शिखिनस्तााश्चतुर्दष्ट्रा विषाणिनः॥
en: Are born with mounts wide open : they are emitting fearful cries. Horses with three legs, with crests, with four teeth and with horns are also born.

sa: त्रिविषाणाश्चतुर्नेवाः पञ्चपादा द्विमेहनाः। द्विशीर्षाश्च द्विपुच्छाश्च दंष्ट्रिणः पशवोऽशिवाः॥
en: Inauspicious beasts, some having three horns, some having four eyes, some five legs, some two sexual organs, some two heads, some two tails, and some fearful teeth.

sa: सर्टिप्रासासिनखराः समुद्गरपरश्वधाः। विच्छिन्ना बाहवः पेतुर्नृणां भल्लैः किरीटिना॥
en: Severed by Kiritin with his board-headed arrows, the arms of men, having swords, lances and rapiers for their nail and grasping bludgeons, mallets and battle-axes, fell down.

sa: अन्योन्यस्पर्धया राजज्ञातयः सङ्गता मिथः। महास्त्राणि विमुञ्चन्तः समापेतुरमर्षिणः॥
en: Then O monarch, those kinsfolk that had met together, burning with jealousy and challenging one another, fell upon one another, discharging mighty weapons at the same time.

sa: प्रपक्षः शकुनिस्तेषां प्रवरैर्हयसादिभिः ययौ गान्धारकैः सार्धं विमलप्रासयोधिभिः॥
en: Then accompanied by a numerous and picked cavalry recruited from men belonging to the Gandhara tribe and armed with lustrous lances, Shakuni marched out as their support.

sa: युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी नियतमानसः। शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति॥
en: Thus constantly devoting his self to abstraction and contemplation, the Yogi whose mind is restrained, attains that peace which culminates in final absorption and assimilation with Me.

sa: ततस्तावागतौ दृष्ट्वा नरनारायणावुभौ। सुप्रसन्नमनाः शर्वः प्रोवाच प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Then beholding them two, viz., Nara and Narayana come to him, Sharva with a delightful heart said these words, as if smiling the whileस्वागतं वो नरश्रेष्ठावुत्तिष्ठेतां गतक्लमौ।

sa: शरांश्चाशीविषाकाराज्वलितान् पन्नगानिव। द्रोणं त्रिभिश्च विव्याध चतुर्भिश्चास्य वाजिनः॥
en: As also, arrows of the shape of snakes of virulent poison, and resembling blazing serpents. In return, he pierced Drona with three shafts, his steeds with four,

sa: स बभौ रथशार्दूलो ललाटे संस्थितैस्त्रिभिः। शिखरैः काञ्चनमयैर्मेरुस्त्रिभिरिवोच्छ्रितैः॥
en: With those three arrows stuck on his forehead, that foremost of men (Drona's son) appeared beautiful like the Meru mountain decked with three golden peaks towering high.

sa: ते गजा गिरिसंकाशाः क्षरन्तः भीमसेनस्य नाराचैर्विमुखा विमदीकृताः॥
en: Those elephants, prodigious like mountains and with ichor exuding from all parts of their bodies, were crushed and compelled to turn back by the Narachas of Bhimasena.

sa: रामस्य जामदग्न्यस्य मार्कण्डेयस्य धीमतः। व्यासनारदयोश्चापि सकाशाद् भरतर्षभ।॥
en: O you conversant with the Shastras, I also heard this from Rama the son of Jamnadagni, from the highly intelligent Markandeya and also from Vyasa and Narada.

sa: शुशुभाते नरव्याघ्रौ युद्धाय समवस्थितौ॥ ततः सात्यकिमभ्येत्य निस्त्रिंशवरधारिणम्।
en: Then those two foremost of men thus standing prepared for the encounter, appeared exceedingly beautiful. Thereafter approaching Satyaki who was armed with a sword of best make,

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम कुन्तीपुत्रस्य पौरुषम्। द्रोणेन वार्यमाणोऽपिनजघ्ने यत् सुतांस्तव॥
en: Then indeed we beheld the wonderful prowess of the son of Kunti, in as much as, though opposed by Drona himself, he succeeded in slaughtering your sons.

sa: स्वबाहुबलवीर्येण नागाश्वरथसंकुलः। महापुरुषभूयिष्ठो धीरयोधनिषेवितः॥ महाव्यूहः कलिङ्गानामेकेन मृदितस्त्वया।
en: The army of the Kalingas, consisting of many thousands of cars, elephants, horses, noble warriors and heroic combatants, has been destroyed by your prowess of arm alone.

sa: भीमसेनस्ततो राजन्नपयाते महाव्रते। प्रजज्वाल यथा वह्निर्दहन् कक्षमिवैधित॥
en: O king, when that great car-warrior was thus carried away from the field of battle, Bhima blazed up like a great fire when it consumes dry grass.

sa: निर्मनुष्याश्च मातङ्गा विनदन्तस्ततस्ततः। छिन्नाभ्राणीव सम्पेतुः सम्प्रविश्य परस्परम्॥
en: Many elephants, deprived of the riders on their backs, coursed wildly hither and thither resembling clouds torn from prodigious masses and they fell down, encountering one another.

sa: क्षत्रधर्मं पुरस्कृत्य आत्मनश्चाभिमानिताम्। प्राप्तेऽपक्रमणे राजा तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: Holding before his mind's eye the paramount duty of a Kshatriya, and also from his own pride, king Duryodhana, through worsted, stood immovable like the everlasting hills.

sa: आगच्छमानान् समरे वार्योधान् प्रलयानिव॥ अवारयन्त संहृष्टास्तावकाः पुरुषर्षभाः।
en: Then those warriors of your army, all foremost of men, cheerfully resisted that onslaught of the Pandavas that looked like a furiously advancing mass of living energy.

sa: तस्याश्वमेधे राजधैर्देशाद्देशात् समीयुषाम्। शिक्षाक्षरविधिज्ञानां नासीत् संख्या विपश्चिताम्॥
en: At the celebration of the horse-sacrifice by him, the number of Brahmanas learned in the Shiksha and Aksharas that then presented themselves from different countries, indeed countless.

sa: सैनामथाब्रवीद् राजन् कृताञ्जलिरनिन्दिता। भीष्मेण समरे रामो निर्जितश्चारुलोचने।॥
en: She then spoke, of whom no one can speak evil, with hands folded to my mother “O faireyed one, Rama has been vanquished in battle by Bhishma.

sa: एवमुक्ता महेष्वासास्ते वीराः क्षिप्रकारिणः। महता शरवर्षेण अभ्यधावन्नरिंदमम्॥
en: Thus spoken to those heroes all mighty bowmen and endued with great lightness of hand, poured a thick shower of arrows on that subduer of his enemies.

sa: द्रोणभीष्माभिसंगुप्तं गुप्तं च कृतवर्मणा॥ कृपदुःशासनाभ्यां च जयद्रथमुखैस्तथा।
en: That army of ours is again protected by Drona and Bhishma; so also it is defended by Kritavarma, Kripa and Dushasana and by others headed by Jayadratha.

sa: नखैर्दन्तैश्च शूराणामद्वीपे द्वीपमिच्छताम्। तत्राच्छिद्यत शूरस्य सखङ्गो बाहुरुद्यतः॥
en: Upraised arms, with swords in grasp, of some heroes, were severed; the arms of others with bows or hook or arrows in grasp, were also lopped off.

sa: अन्योन्यं हि रणे शूराः केशेष्वाक्षिप्यमानिनः। नखदन्तैरयुध्यन्त मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिस्तथा॥
en: In that battle the warriors, O sire, dragging one another by the hair, fought on striking one another with their finger-nails, their teeth, their blows and thighs,

sa: रुक्मदण्डां महाशक्तिं प्रेषितां सौमदत्तिना। शितेनोरगसंकाशां पत्रिणापजहार ताम्॥
en: With another sharp arrow, he cut down the great dare with a golden staff which resembled a snake and which was hurled against him by Somadatta's son.

sa: प्राग्ज्योतिषपते गः संनिवृत्यापसृत्य च॥ पार्वे दशार्णाधिपतेर्भित्त्वा नागमपातयत्।
en: Thereafter the elephant of the ruler of the Pragjyotisas, turning and wheeling round, slew the elephant of the king of the Dasarnas, by ripping open its flanks.

sa: पद्मवर्णस्त्वनीकानां सर्वेषामग्रतः स्थितः॥ अश्वत्थामा ययौ यत्तः सिंहलाङ्गलकेतुना।
en: The lotus-complexioned Ashvatthama ever ready for emergency marched at the very head of all the troops with his standard hat bore the device of a lion's tail.

sa: शिशुपालसुतो वीश्चेदिराजो महारथः। धृष्टकेतुर्महेष्वासः सम्बन्धी पाण्डवस्य ह॥
en: Dhrishtaketu, the king of the Chedis, the son of Shishupala, is a Maharatha and is also a mighty bowman; besides he is related to the Pandu king.

sa: अन्योन्यं ते समासाद्य कुरुपाण्डवसैनिकाः। अस्त्रैर्नानाविधैर्घोरै रणे निन्युर्यमक्षयम्॥
en: The combatants of the Kuru and the Pandava troops nearing one another, began to dispatch one another to the regions of death, with arrows of diverse shapes.

sa: सर्वपार्थिववीराणां संनिधौ पूजयन्निव। नैतच्चित्रं महाबाहो त्वयि कौरवनन्दन।॥
en: Applauding him before all the heroic rulers of earth. “O mighty-armed hero, this feat is not a marvel in respect to you, O delighter of the Kurus.

sa: गाण्डीवशब्दं तमथो विदित्वा विराटराजप्रमुखाः प्रवीराः। स्तं देशमाजग्मुरदीनसत्त्वाः॥
en: In that fierce battle, the sounds of conchs and beat of drums and the deep rattle of cars were all silenced by the twang of the Gandiva.

sa: छादयाञ्चक्रिरे शरैः। प्रावृषीव महाराज जलदा इव पर्वतम्॥
en: Your sons, o king, covered that son of Kunti with a shower of arrows like clouds covering a mountain with torrents of rain during the rainy season.

sa: तस्याभिद्रवतो वाहान् हस्तमुक्तेन वारिणा॥ सिक्त्वा व्यत्रासयन्नागस्ते पार्थमहरंस्ततः।
en: Then that elephant drenching with the water spouting from its trunk the horses of the advancing Bhima, frightened them and they carried away Bhima from the field.

sa: अस्त्रमस्त्रेण सर्वेषामेतेषां मधुसूदन। मया द्रक्ष्यसि निर्भिन्नं जयद्रथवधैषिणा॥
en: You will see, O slayer of Madhu, the weapons of all these heroes cut-off by those of mine, when, desirous of slaying Jayadratha, I shall encounter them.

sa: विमृद्यैवं महानागान् ममर्दान्यान् महाबलः। अश्वारोहवरादंश्चैव पातयामास संयुगे॥
en: Having thus killed many huge elephants that foremost of men then began to destroy the horses. O descendant of Bharata, that hero felled many foremost of horse-men.

sa: लावणस्य समुद्रस्य विष्कम्भो द्विगुणः स्मृतः। नानाजनपदाकीर्णो मणिविदुमचित्रितः॥
en: The extent of the salt sea is said to be double of it. this sea is covered with many kingdoms. It is adorned with gems and corals.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासो द्रोणपुत्रेण सात्वतः। द्रोणपुत्रं त्रिभिर्बाणैराजघान महायशाः॥
en: Then that illustrious descendant of the Satvata race that great bowman thus deeply pierced by the son of Drona struck the latter with three shafts in return.

sa: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय वेगवान् क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। अमृष्यमाणः पार्थेन कार्मुकच्छेदमाहवे॥
en: Then the latter, endued with great impetuosity, overwhelmed with fury, not broO king the severing of his bow by Partha (Arjuna) in the battle, grasped another bow,

sa: अन्यानपि महाराज तापयामास पार्थिवान्। पराङ्मुखीकृत्य तथा शरवधर्महारथान्॥
en: He felled also, O mighty monarch, many rulers of the earth all mighty car-warriors, having compelled them to turn their faces away from the field of battle.

sa: मृदुकुञ्चितकेशान्तं बालं वालमृगेक्षणम्। मत्तद्विरदविक्रान्तं शालपोतमिवोद्गतम्॥ स्मिताभिभाषिणं दन्तं गुरुवाक्यकरं सदा। बाल्येऽप्यतुलकर्माणं प्रियवाक्यममत्सरम्॥ महोत्साहं महाबाहुं दीर्घराजीवलोचनम्। भक्तानुकम्पिनं दान्तं न च नीचानुसारिणम्॥ कृतज्ञं ज्ञानसम्पन्नं कृतास्त्रमनिवर्तिनम्। युद्धाभिनन्दिनं नित्यं द्विषतां भयवर्धनम्॥ स्वेषां प्रियहिते युक्तं पितॄणां जयगृद्धिनम्। न च पूर्वं प्रहर्तारं संग्रामे नष्टसम्भ्रमम्॥ यदि पुत्रं न पश्यामि यास्मामि यमसादनम्।
en: Possessed of soft and curling hair-ends, of tender years, of eyes like those of a young gazelle graced with the tread of an infuriate elephant, resembling an offshoot of a Shala tree. Of sweet speeches attended with smiles, modest, ever ready to carry out the behests of his venerables, achieving in tender years, feats worthy of mature age, sweet-spoken, free from animosity. Of mighty energy and prowess, of eyes resembling large lotus-petals, ever merciful towards his followers, self-possessed, never pursuing mean objects and men. Ever grateful, endued with the knowledge of all things, unretreating and accomplished in the use of all kinds of weapons, ever delighting in battle and ever enhancing the terror of his adversaries. Always intent on bringing about the welfare of his own party, ever

sa: तदा मन्सते त्रिदिवादिवाशुचे निवर्तिता पार्थ महाप्रशासनात्। प्रशाम्य राज्यं हि सुदुर्लभं त्वया बुभूषितः स्वर्ग इवातपस्विना॥
en: Then, O son of Pritha, will your mind be turned from the thought of ruling over the earth like one who has lived a life of infamy giving up all hopes of heaven. To win a kingdom for you is as difficult as to obtain heaven for a man who has never practiced devotion.

sa: चूडामणिषु निष्केषु भूषणेष्वपि वर्मसु। तेषामादित्यवर्णाभा रश्मयः प्रचकाशिरे॥
en: On the gems embosscd on their head-gears, on their necklaces ornaments and armours, rays of light, like the rays of the sun, were seen to be reflected.

sa: गमिताः परलोकाय परमास्त्रैः किरीटिना। अहन्यहनि संक्रुद्धास्तावकानां महारथाः॥
en: Day after day, the irate mighty car-warriors of your armny were conveyed to the regions of the departed by the excellent weapons shot by the diadem-decked Arjuna.

sa: तत् सरोऽथावतीर्याशु प्रभूतनलिनोत्पलम्। महागज इवोद्दामश्चिक्रीड बलवद् बली॥
en: Going down to the waters of that lake adorned with innumerable lotuses and lilies, that greatly powerful hero sported merrily there like a mighty elephant in rut.

sa: सर्वथाधर्मनित्यं तु पुरुषंधर्मदुर्बलम्। त्यजतस्तात्धर्मार्थों प्रेतं दुःखसुखे यथा॥
en: O sire, virtue is sometimes (the indirect cause of) the weakness of men. Dharina and Artha forsake such men, as pain and pleasure forsake a dead man.

sa: शतशश्च कुथांस्तत्र सिंहलाः समुपाहरन्। संवृता मणिचीरैस्तु श्यामास्ताम्रान्तलोचनाः॥
en: And hundreds of coverlets for elephants were presented by the kings of the Singhalas. Innumerable dark-coloured men with copper coloured eyes, attired with robes adorned with gems.

sa: अश्वमेधे हयं मेध्यमुत्सृष्टं रक्षिभिर्वृतम्। पितुर्मे यज्ञविघ्नार्थमहरत् पापनिश्चयः॥
en: This wretch, sinful in all his purposes, in order to obstruct my father's sacrifice, stole the horse of the horse-sacrifice which was let loose under armed guards.

sa: ततः संवर्तको वह्निर्वायुना सह भारत। लोकमाविशते पूर्वमादित्यैरुपशोषितम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, then the fire (called) Samvartaka helped by the wind appears on earth which has been already burnt (to ashes) by the seven suns.

sa: कुबेरसदनं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसांश्च निपातितान्। भ्राता भ्रातरमासीनमब्रवीत् पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: (And) the lord of the Earth, (Yudhishthira), having beheld the abode of Kubera and those Rakshasas killed (by Bhima), addressed his brother (Bhima) who was seated, thus

sa: यस्य दी? समौ पीनौ भुजौ परिघसंनिभौ। मौर्वीकृतकिणौ वृत्तौ खङ्गायुधधनुर्धरौ॥ निष्काइदकृतापीडौ पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ। तमृते पुरुषव्याघ्रं नष्टसूर्यमिवाम्बरम्॥
en: (Without him), whose arms are long, symmetrical, stout and mace-like, which are round and marked with the scars of the bowstrings, which are ground with the bow, the sword and the other weapons, encircled with golden bracelets, like two five-headed snakes, without that foremost of men, the sky seems to have lost the sun.

sa: सर्वसंशयनिर्मोक्ता नारदः सर्वलोकवित्। उवाचाखिलभूतानां मध्ये स्पष्टतरं वचः॥
en: The dispeller of all doubts, Narada learned in(the mysteries) of all the world, then said in the midst of innumerable creatures these words of the clearest import.

sa: शम्भुमग्निमथ प्राहुर्ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः। आवसथ्यं द्विजाः प्राहुर्दीप्तमग्नि महाप्रभम्॥
en: The Brahmanas learned in the Vedas then speak of the deeds of the fire named Shambhu. Then the Brahmanas speak of the greatly effulgent fire (called) Avasathya.

sa: ताभिराभरणैः शब्दस्वासिताभिः समीरितः। शिलानामिव शैलेषु पतन्तीनामभूत् तदा॥
en: Thereupon, there arose a sound of the falling of the ornaments (from the persons) of those terrified ladies like the sound of hail falling upon a mountain.

sa: तं जटाजिनसंवीतं तपोवननिवासिनम्। समाजग्मुर्महात्मानं द्रष्टुं मुनिगणाः प्रभो॥
en: Attiring himself in deer skin and wearing matted locks, he is living in the forest in asceticism. O lord, many Rishis have assembled there to see him.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा शिशुपालस्तानुत्थाय परमासनात्। निर्ययौ सदसस्तस्मात् सहितो राजभिस्तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this, Shishupala rose from the excellent seat (on which he was seated). He then went out of the assembly accompanied by the kings.

sa: ततो देवह्रदेऽरण्ये कृष्णवेणाजलोद्भवे॥ जातिस्मरहदे स्नात्वा भवेज्जातिस्मरो नरः।
en: Then bathing in the charining Devahrada supplied with water by Krishna Vena. And also bathing in the Jatismarahrada, a man obtains the recollection of his former births.

sa: कुरूणामृषभं पार्थं पूजयित्वा महातपाः। सह भ्रातृभिरासीनं पर्यपृच्छदनामयम्॥
en: Then that one of great devotion having welcomed Partha, the best of the Kurus, who had taken his seat with his brothers, inquired after his welfare saying,

sa: स नित्यमन्तरप्रेप्सुनिषधेष्ववसच्चिरम्। अथास्य द्वादशे वर्षे ददर्श कलिरन्तरम्॥
en: Always intent on detecting a flaw in Nala, he resided in the country of the Nishadhas. In the twelfth vear Kali found out a fault of his.

sa: ततोऽहमपि कौन्तेय शराणामयुतान् बहून्। आमन्त्रितानांधनुषा दिव्येन विधिनाक्षिपम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, thereupon I too discharged from my bows tens of thousands of arrows inspiring them with proper Mantras and shooting them with celestials methods.

sa: अनन्तरिक्षे लोकेऽस्मिन् देवदानववर्जिते। त्वमेव प्रलये विप्र ब्रह्माणमुपतिष्ठसे॥
en: O Brahmana, you worship Brahma at the time of the great dissolution of the universe when this world becomes devoid of sky, the celestials and the Danavas.

sa: वितस्तां पश्य राजेन्द्र सर्वपापप्रमोचनीम्। महर्षिभिश्चाध्युषितां शीततोयां सुनिर्मलाम्॥
en: O king of kings, behold Vitasta which cleanses all sins. The water of it is very cool and transparent and it is frequented by the great Rishis.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं मैत्रावरुणिरच्युतः। समुद्रमपिबत् क्रुद्धः सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Having spoken these few words, the undeteriorating son of Mitra and Varuna began in wrath to drink up the ocean in the sight of all the world.

sa: देवदानवगन्धर्वयक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः। नासन् कृतयुगे तात तदा न क्रयविक्रयः॥
en: O child, in the Krita Yuga there were no celestials, no Danavas, no Gandharvas, no Yakshas, no Rakshasas and no Nagas. There was neither buying nor selling.

sa: समानोदानयोर्मध्ये प्राणापानौ समाहितौ। समर्थितस्त्वधिष्ठानं सम्यक् पचति पावकः॥
en: The Prana and the Apana airs are interposed within the Samana and the Udana airs. The heat generated by their coalition causes the growth of the body.

sa: अनेनैव पथा राजन् प्रतिगच्छ यथागतम्। नरनारायणस्थानं बदरीत्यभिविश्रुतम्॥
en: By this way, O king, go back from this place to the place whence you have come, to the hermitage of Nara Narayana which is called Badari.

sa: तदहं यष्टुमिच्छामि दाशार्ह सहितस्त्वया। अनुजैश्च महाबाहो तनमानुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: O prince of the Dasarha race, O mighty armed hero, you should grant me permission to celebrate the Rajasuya sacrifice along with you and with my brothers.

sa: मया स पुरुषव्याघ्रो जिष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः। अस्त्रहेतोर्महाबाहुरमितात्मा विवासितः॥
en: Yudhishthira said : I have sent away for the acquisition of weapons, that foremost of men, that irresistibly powerful and the mighty-aried Vishnu (Arjuna) of immeasurable intelligence.

sa: बहवः सम्प्रदृश्यन्ते तुल्यनक्षत्रमङ्गलाः। महच्च फलवैषम्यं दृश्यते कर्मसंधिषु॥
en: Many persons are born under the influence of the same star and the same auspicious good luck, but a great diversity is observed in all their actions.

sa: दुःखेन चाधिगच्छन्ति भोजनं द्विजसत्तम। इति लोकमनाक्रन्दं मोहशोकपरिप्लुतम्॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, they are enabled to eain their livelihood with (only) good deal of difficulty. Thus men are helpless, afflicted with grief and illusion and

sa: वार्ष्णेयान् हारहूणांश्च कृष्णान् हैमवतांस्तथा। नीपानूपानधिगतान् विविधान् द्वारवारितान्॥
en: The Vrishnis, the Harahunas, the dark people of the Himalayas, the Nipas and the people living on the sea coast, were all refused admittance at the gate.

sa: वृष्टिमारुतसंतापैः सुखैः स्थावरजङ्गमान्। वर्धयन् सुमहातेजाः पुनः प्रतिनिवर्तते॥
en: And having nourished all (creatures) both mobile and immobile by the comfort caused by rain, wind and warmth, that one of mighty splendour resumes his (former) course.

sa: उत्सङ्गे च व्याल इवाहितोऽसि मार्जारवत् पोषकं चोपहंसि। स्तस्मात् क्षत्तः किं न बिभेषि पापात्॥
en: You are kept by us on our lap as a serpent. Like a cat you wish to injure him who cherishes you. The wise men have said that there is no sin greater than that of injuring one's supporter. O Khattwa, how is it that you do not fear sin?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ते शूरास्ततधन्वानस्तूणवन्तः समार्गणाः। बद्धगोधाङ्गलित्राणाः खड्गवन्तोऽमितौजसः॥ परिगृह्य द्विजश्रेष्ठाज्येष्ठाः सर्वधनुष्मताम्। पाञ्चालीसहिता राजन् प्रययुर्गन्धमादनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, then those foremost of bow men, those immeasurably effulgent heroes, equipped with quivers and arrows and armed with swords and holding bows stringed at full and wearing finger protector made of guana-skin, went towards the Gandhamadana, with the Panchal princess and the best of Brahmanas.

sa: ततो ब्रह्मा नमश्चक्रे देवाय हरिमेधसे। धर्मं चाम्यं स जग्राह सरहस्यं ससंग्रहम्॥ आरण्यकेन सहितं नारायणमुखोद्भवम्। उपदिश्य ततो धर्मं ब्रह्मणेऽमिततेजसे॥ त्वं कर्ता युगधर्माणां निराशी:कर्मसंज्ञितम्। जगाम तमसः पारं यत्राव्यक्तं व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Thus addressed, Brahman bowed his head to the illustrious Harimedhas and received from him that foremost of all religions with all its mysteries and abstract of details, together with the Aranyakas,-the religion which originated from the mouth of Narayana. Narayana then instructed Brahman of incomparable energy in that religion, and addressing him, said,-You are the creator of the duties that are to be observed in the respective cycles! Having said. this to Brahman, Narayana disappeared and went to that place which is beyond the reach of Ignorance, where the unmanifest resides, and which is known by the name of acts without desire of fruits.

sa: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्। विविधा च तथा चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्॥
en: He is the basis on which all things depend. He is the doer or agent, and He is the cause of that variety in the universe. He is the various kinds of power which act in the universe. Fifthly, he is that all controlling unseen power of which people speak.

sa: स हि लोकयोनिरमृतस्य पदं सूक्ष्म परायणमचलं हि पदम्। तत्सांख्योगिभिरुदार वृतं बुद्ध्या यतात्मभिरिदं सनातनम्॥
en: He is the origin of the universe. He is that Being who is called Eternal. He is Minute. He is the refuge upon whom all things depend. He is the one Being who is immutable. The Sankhyas and Yogins, of controlled souls, hold him who is eternal in their understanding.

sa: ततोऽस्य सशरं चापं क्षुरप्रेण द्विधाच्छिनत्॥ सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय लघुहस्तस्ततो दृढम्। सात्यकिळसृजचापि शरश्रेणी सुतस्य ते॥
en: Discharging then a Kshurapra (razorheaded arrow) he cut-off in two, Satyaki's bow with arrows fixed thereon ; Satyaki, thereupon with great lightness of hands, grasped a tougher bow and began to shoot a shower of shafts at your son. As those lines of arrows flew for bringing about Duryodhana's death.

sa: नरपतिरभवत् सदैवताभ्यः प्रयतमनास्त्वभिसंस्तुवंश्च ता:स्म। न च धुरि नृप गामयुक्त भूय स्तुरगवरैरगमच्च यत्र तत्र॥
en: The Kuru king from that day became very attentive of kine and always adored them, singing their praises. From that day, the king gave up the practice of yO king kine to his cars. Wherever he had occasion to go, he proceeded on cars drawn by horses of good breed.

sa: पुत्रकामो हि पुत्रार्थं यां वृणीते विशाम्पते। क्षेत्रजं तु प्रमाणं स्यान्न वै तत्रात्मजः सुतः॥
en: When a man, desiring to have a son, marries a girl quick with child, the son born of his wife must belong to him, for it is the fruit of his own soil. The person from whose vital seed the son has sprung, can have no right to such son.

sa: त्रैलोक्यं येन सम्भ्रान्तमातापितमिवाभवत्। ततो देवर्षिगन्धर्वाः पन्नगोरगराक्षसाः॥ मोहितास्तपसा तस्य तेजसा मन्दरश्मयः। कश्मलोपहताः सर्वे पितामहमथाब्रुवन्॥
en: And at this, the three worlds became afflicted with fear. And bewildered on account of the energy of his asceticisin, and shorn of their brightness, and afflicted with anguish, the Devarsis and the Gandharvas and the Pannagas and the Uragas and the Rakşasas in a body addressed the Pitāmaha, (Brahmā).

sa: नास्तिक्यमनृतं क्रोधं प्रमादं दीर्घसूत्रताम्। अदर्शनं ज्ञानवतामालस्यं पञ्चवृत्तिताम्॥ एकचिन्तनमर्थानामनर्थज्ञैश्च मन्त्रणम्। निश्चितानामनारम्भं मन्त्रस्यापरिरक्षणम्॥ मङ्गलाद्यप्रयोगं च प्रत्युत्थानं च सर्वतः। कच्चित् त्वं वर्जयस्येतान् राजदोषांश्चतुर्दश॥
en: Atheism, untruthfulness, inattention, anger, procrastination, companionship with evil persons, indolence, gratification of the senses, consultation with a single person concerning the needs of a kingdom, taking counsel with those that are cognisant of evils alone, omission to take in hand a task that has been decided upon, divulgence of counsel, non-commencement of a course in the morning, and marching against all the foes at one and the same time, have you eschewed these ten and four faults?

sa: तत्राहं दुर्बलावन्धौ वृद्धावपरिणायकौ। अपश्यं तस्य पितरौ लूनपक्षाविव द्विजौ॥ तन्निमित्ताभिरासीनौ कथाभिरपरिश्रमौ। तामाशां मत्कृते हीनावुपासीनावनाथवत्॥
en: There I found his aged, infirm, forlorn, parents, without any one to help them in moving about, like to birds whose wings have been severed, keeping up a talk about (their son) without experiencing any fatigue, and like helpless ones feeding on a hope which had been blasted by me.

sa: सरस्वत्युवाच तं वै परं वेदविदः प्रपन्नाः परं परेभ्यः प्रथितं पुराणम्। स्तपोधना वीतशोका विमुक्ताः॥
en: Sarasvati replied : Position of Brahman all immortal is for which the yogis observed regular perseverance and consider austerity as only wealth and ultimately get-read of the net work of agony as a result of taking over that supreme position. The experts in Vedas shelter to that very supreme position.

sa: ततोऽभ्यगच्छन् सहिताः :स्वनम्। नृत्यन्तमिव चोर्मीभिर्वल्गन्तमिव वायुना॥ हसन्तमिव फेनौधैः स्खलन्तं कन्दरेषु च। नानाग्राहसमाकीर्णं नानाद्विजगणान्वितम्॥
en: They then all came to the fearfully roaring ocean which was as it were dancing with billows made by the winds and was, as it were laughing with masses of froth, created by the dashing of waves at the mountain cave. It was full of different water animals and birds.

sa: य एष रक्षःशार्दूलो रणभूमिं विराजयत्। अभ्येति रथिनां श्रेष्ठो रथेनादित्यवर्चसा॥ ध्वजशृङ्गप्रतिष्ठेन राहुणाभिविराजते। सूर्यरश्मिप्रभैर्बाणर्दिशो दश विराजयन्॥ त्रिनतं मेघनिदिं हेमपृष्ठमलंकृतम्। शतक्रतुधनुःप्रख्यं धनुश्चास्य विराजते॥
en: Who is this foremost of Räkşasas and best of bowmen that embellishing the field of battle, approach on a car glorious as the sun; who, . displaying the ten cardinal points with his shafts resembling the rays of the sun, appear handsome with his peak of a banner bearing the figure of Rāhu, whose bow bent in three places, emitting roars resembling the rumbling of clouds, and plated with gold, look like the bow itself of Satakratu?

sa: दृषद्वतीं चाप्यवगाह्य सुव्रताः कृतोदकार्थाः कृतजष्यमङ्गलाः। उपास्य संध्यां विधिवत् परंतर्पा स्तत: पुरं ते विविशुर्गजाह्वयम्॥
en: All of them, observant of excellent vows, then bathed in the river Drishadvati-Having offered oblations of water to their departed manes and silently recited the sacred mantras and performed other auspicious rites, and having adored the evening twilight with due rites, those scorchers of enemies entered the city of Hastinapur.

sa: अथ तस्मिन्ननागच्छति, सूर्ये चास्ताचलावलम्बिनि उपाध्यायः शिष्यानवोचत्-'नायात्युपमन्युः।' ते ऊचु 'वनं गतो गा रक्षितुम्' इति॥
en: As he did not return that day to the Rishi's house when the sun was sinking down behind the summit of the western mountain, the preceptor said to his pupils that Upamanyu had not yet returned. And they replied that he had gone to the forest to tend the cattle.

sa: कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन व्यसनेन प्रसङ्गिना।७२।। निवृत्तस्त्वत्कृते नार्थः सोऽयं मूलहरो महान्। त्वया कृतमिदं सर्वमनाथं राक्षस कुलम्॥
en: This destruction of the leading Rākṣasas has proceeded from the disaster arising from your anger and lust. For your (vicious) deeds all our good fortune is lost-(and from them) has proceeded the great disaster exterminating the race. And by you all the Raksasa families have been deprived of their lords.

sa: निवेद्यतां दाशरथेऋषयो वयमागताः। प्रतीहारस्ततस्तूर्णमगस्त्यवचनाद्भुतम्॥ समीपं राघवस्याशु प्रविवेश महात्मनः। नयेङ्गितिज्ञः सद्वृत्तो दक्षो धैर्यसमन्वितः॥ स रामं दृश्य सहसा पूर्णचन्द्रसमद्युतिम्। अगस्त्यं कथयामास संप्राप्तमृषिसत्तमम्॥
en: Then at the words of Agastya, the gate-keeper quick* and swift presented himself with celerity before the high-souled Rāghava. And that one versed in polity and emotional expressions, of worthy ways, possessed of ability, and endowed with patience swiftly seeing Rāma resembling the full moon in brightness, communicated to him the arrival of that supreme of saintsAgastya. *Turnam-according to the commentator, is mental celerity, and drutam-physical. This distinction, however, is seldom, if ever, observed by Sanskrit authors.

sa: विधूतकेशी युवतिर्यथा मृदितवर्णका। निपीतशुभदन्तोष्ठी नखैर्दन्तैश्च विक्षता॥ तथा लालहस्तैस्तु चरणाभ्यां च मर्दिता। तथैवाशोकवनिका प्रभग्नवनपादपा॥
en: And like youthful fair ones with hair dishevelled, their paste worn off, their upper lips with fair teeth sucked of their moisture; and having their persons torn with nails, and teeth; appeared 'the Asoka wood with its trees shattered; and itself ground with the tail, hands and legs (of Hanumān).
